assets.title: Advisor Client Financial Review Meeting
assets.detailedDescription: High-resolution vertical portrait of a professional one-on-one business meeting in a modern glass-walled office. A suited advisor (navy suit, tie) is explaining printed charts and graphs on a clipboard to a casually dressed client (light-blue shirt) across a glossy wooden table. On the table are a laptop, scattered report pages with bar/line charts, a closed black notebook, a pen, and a white coffee mug. Warm shelf lighting and potted plants are visible in the background, while daylight from large windows creates a cool fill. The scene shows natural, engaged expressions, crisp document detail, and a strong reflection of the subjects on the table surface.
assets.useCase: Mid-shot B-roll or hero frame for a short reel illustrating financial advisory, client consultation, sales pitch, onboarding, or portfolio review.

assets.title: Advisor Explaining Financial Report
assets.detailedDescription: Vertical portrait photograph of a one-on-one office consultation: a suited advisor in a navy suit and tie points with a pen to a printed financial report with blue charts while the client, seated across a glass-topped desk with a laptop, listens attentively. Warm interior lighting, beige textured walls, a table lamp and shelving occupy the softly blurred background. The composition is a mid-close shot with shallow depth of field, natural window light from the left, and subtle reflections on the desk surface. Framing centers the advisor’s gesture and the document, emphasizing the interaction and information exchange.
assets.useCase: Mid-shot cutaway in a short reel showing a financial advisor explaining a report to a client — ideal for banking, wealth management, loan consultation, or corporate explainer scenes.

assets.title: Advisor Explains Charts To Client Office Meeting
assets.detailedDescription: Photorealistic mid-shot of two male professionals seated at a wooden desk in a modern office. The advisor (wearing a navy suit and tie) holds and points at a printed page of colorful bar and pie charts with a pen while the client (in a light grey button-up) listens attentively with hands clasped. Foreground shows a small potted plant, open folders and a closed tablet; background features a blurred glass partition and warm shelving with a small framed photo and plant. Warm, even office lighting and shallow depth of field emphasize the interaction and the printed data.
assets.useCase: Mid-shot cutaway for a short reel illustrating client advisory, financial review, sales consultation, or onboarding scenes in corporate videos.

assets.title: Advisor Pointing At Financial Report
assets.detailedDescription: Vertical photorealistic image of a formal office consultation: a well-dressed advisor in a navy suit and tie sits at a glossy desk, pointing with a pen at a printed financial report while speaking to a seated client across the table. A laptop, clipboard, and paperwork are visible on the desk. Soft natural light from a large window on the left and warm interior lighting create a balanced, professional atmosphere with beige wood paneling and a table lamp in the background. Composition is a medium-close, over-the-shoulder view emphasizing the advisor's hand, the document, and the engaged interaction.
assets.useCase: Use as a vertical B-roll insert in a short reel showing a financial advisor explaining a report during client onboarding, loan or investment consultations, or corporate service promos; works well as a cutaway while narration describes advisory services.

assets.title: Ai Test Watermark Tile
assets.detailedDescription: A high-contrast tiled placeholder/watermark image composed of many repeating cells of legible black sans-serif text reading a generative-AI test message on a clean white background. The text is arranged in a tight rectangular grid with thin dividers, producing a repetitive, informational texture. Subtle accent colors (a narrow magenta vertical seam and faint cyan margin) appear near the edges, giving a small visual anchor while the overall composition reads as a utilitarian test or placeholder pattern rather than a decorative background.
assets.useCase: Short reel intro or interstitial frame to signal a generative-AI test or placeholder — works as a full-screen background, semi-transparent overlay, or behind lower-thirds during tech demos, tutorials, or testing clips (1–3s shots).

assets.title: Ai Typographic Tile Background
assets.detailedDescription: Square, high-contrast typographic texture made from a dense, repeating phrase tiled across the canvas. Black sans-serif text is repeated in varying sizes and slight rotations on a white background, producing a seamless, readable pattern that reads as a tiled ‘this image is ai’ style message. The arrangement creates a visual texture with small alignment offsets and light grain, useful as a neutral but information-forward backdrop or overlay for tech and AI-related content.
assets.useCase: Serves as a looping background or overlay in short reels and tech explainers — ideal behind titles, lower-thirds, AI-disclaimer cards, transitions, or as subtle b-roll texture in social media videos.

assets.title: Airport Terminal Gates Lounges Signage
assets.detailedDescription: Vertical photorealistic image of a busy modern airport terminal interior. Centered overhead black and yellow directional sign reads 'Gates 1-26' (arrow up), 'Lounges' (left arrow) and 'Toilets' with accessibility icons and Hindi translations. Long depth-of-field shows a bright glass facade to the right, curved ceiling with white structural columns, polished reflective floor and a crowd of travelers walking toward the gates with rolling suitcases and backpacks. Retail signage (WHSmith, The Square) and electronic departure boards appear in the midground. Strong leading lines and high contrast between the yellow-on-black signage and the neutral architecture create a clear focal point. Natural daylight from the windows illuminates the scene; faces are non-identifiable.
assets.useCase: Establishing or B-roll shot for travel videos, app splash screens, transport wayfinding visuals, or transitions in a short reel showing airport arrival and navigation.

assets.title: Analyst Over Shoulder Laptop Dashboard
assets.detailedDescription: Vertical photorealistic image of a professional man in a white dress shirt seated at a wooden desk, typing on a laptop that displays an analytics/dashboard UI (pie chart and data tables visible but softly blurred). Warm desk lamp light and a small potted plant sit behind the laptop; a notebook and pen rest on the desk beside the computer. The composition is an over-the-shoulder mid-close shot with a softly blurred background, creating a focused, intimate corporate work atmosphere.
assets.useCase: B-roll mid-close over-the-shoulder shot for product demos, SaaS dashboard showcases, corporate explainer reels, training videos, or cutaway scenes in finance and analytics stories.

assets.title: Angry Young Man Street Fight India
assets.detailedDescription: Vertical, photorealistic mid-action shot of a tense young South Asian man throwing a punch in a dusty urban alley. His shirt is dirt-stained and torn, his face bruised and smeared with blood and sweat; two other battered men are visible in the background and foreground, creating a layered three-person composition. The setting shows weathered buildings and a sign with Devanagari script, indicating a South Asian locale. Natural daylight, warm desaturated tones, and gritty textures emphasize a raw, cinematic fight sequence.
assets.useCase: Insert vertical action shot for a short reel or trailer to convey a gritty street fight, escalation beat, or character confrontation moment.

assets.title: Aspiring Actor Bollywood Casting Call Street
assets.detailedDescription: Photorealistic medium close-up of a young South Asian man standing on a busy urban street in front of a large 'BOLLYWOOD' arch and a visible 'Bollywood Casting Call' poster. He wears a light striped button-up shirt, carries a worn shoulder bag, and clenches his fist to his chest while looking upward with a hopeful, determined smile. The background shows a crowded street, movie billboards, and an auto-rickshaw, rendered with shallow depth of field and warm, filmic color grading. Natural sunlight highlights his face and textured clothing, producing a cinematic, aspirational atmosphere focused on ambition and the dream of auditioning.
assets.useCase: Establishing B-roll or cutaway in a short reel about chasing dreams, Bollywood auditions, or an actor's journey—works as an opening montage shot, social promo, or documentary insert.

assets.title: Atm Queue Urban Business Casual
assets.detailedDescription: Photorealistic vertical shot of an outdoor ATM mounted in a modern building facade with a line of four adults waiting to use it. The foreground shows a man in dress pants and brown shoes actively using the ATM, inserting a card or pressing keys. Behind him are three queued individuals in business-casual attire (jeans, button-up shirts, backpack, handbag) standing on a city sidewalk; their body language is neutral and patient. The scene is lit by natural daylight with soft shadows, a reflective glass wall in the background, and a shallow depth of field that keeps the ATM user and immediate queue in focus while slightly blurring the background. Colors are muted and professional — navy, light blue, gray, and earth tones — with stainless-steel ATM details and subtle urban textures.
assets.useCase: Cutaway or establishing shot in a short reel about banking, ATM usage, queue management, urban finance services, or everyday commute scenes; fits well as a transition or B-roll clip.

assets.title: Bank Advisor Elderly Consultation
assets.detailedDescription: Vertical photorealistic portrait of a young male bank advisor in a light blue shirt and navy tie consulting with an elderly male client across a wood-finish service counter. The advisor smiles and holds a document while the client, seated in a black chair and wearing beige clothing, listens and touches the paper. A computer monitor and keyboard sit on the counter; the background shows a modern office with frosted glass panels with horizontal stripes and warm recessed ceiling lights. Natural, warm color tones and shallow depth of field emphasize the interpersonal interaction and paperwork exchange.
assets.useCase: Short-reel B-roll or hero shot for bank websites, financial service ads, onboarding or explainer videos showing a customer consultation, account setup, or retirement planning meeting.

assets.title: Bank Advisor Senior Client Consultation Vertical
assets.detailedDescription: Photorealistic vertical portrait of a young male bank advisor in a light blue shirt and navy tie speaking with an elderly male client across a wood-tone service counter. The scene shows a computer monitor at the desk, warm wood paneling and beige walls in the background, and a reflective marble-like countertop in the foreground. The desk holds a small potted plant, a pen cup and printed brochures. Background shows additional staff at computer workstations and warm orange accent walls with soft overhead lighting. The background shows a modern, well-lit bank interior with warm overhead lighting and softly blurred staff and lobby details. The image emphasizes interpersonal service, clear customer-facing documentation, and a professional branch environment.

assets.title: Beige Microtext Tile Green Bar Teal Dotspinner
assets.detailedDescription: A dense, tileable abstract texture made from repeated micro-type printed across a warm beige background. The pattern is overlaid with a short horizontal green rectangle near the top-left and a teal dotted circular accent (spinner-like) near the top-right. High-contrast black micro-text creates a halftone/typographic noise effect; overall composition reads as an aged/analog print or glitchy editorial background rather than a photograph.
assets.useCase: Use as a looping background or layered plate for short social reels, title cards, lower-thirds, or transitions where a busy typographic texture and a pop of green/teal accent enhance contrast for overlaid text or UI elements.

assets.title: Bengaluru Kr Market Ksrtc Bus Station
assets.detailedDescription: Vertical photorealistic photo of Bengaluru's K.R. Market KSRTC bus station showing a crowded platform area and multiple KSRTC buses lined up at bays. Foreground shows two frontal buses (white-blue and red-grey livery) and dozens of commuters with luggage and backpacks walking or waiting; an overhead bilingual signboard in Kannada and English spans the top of the frame, with numbered bay markers (14, 15, 18) and urban buildings and telecom masts visible in the background under an overcast sky.
assets.useCase: Establishing or transition shot in a short reel to show crowded public transportation, urban commute, or travel in Bengaluru.

assets.title: Blinkit Delivery Motorbike Backshot Yellow
assets.detailedDescription: Photorealistic rear-angle shot of a delivery rider on a motorcycle in an urban Indian street. The rider wears a bright yellow polo with the 'blinkit' logo and the tagline 'India's Last Minute App' printed on the back; a matching insulated yellow delivery bag with reflective strip and the same branding is mounted on the bike. The scene shows mid-day natural light, shallow depth of field, tree-lined avenue, multi-storey buildings and stopped traffic in the background. Framing centers on the rider's back and the branded bag, capturing texture in the fabric, reflective strip details, helmet-less head, and a visible license plate on the scooter. Suitable for app promo, social ads, or hero shots emphasizing fast urban delivery and brand visibility.
assets.useCase: Establishing or mid-roll shot in a short promo or social reel for a delivery app—shows brand visibility and urban last-mile delivery in motion, ideal for transitions, lower-thirds, or product feature overlays.

assets.title: Business Consultation Over Desk
assets.detailedDescription: Photorealistic shot of two South Asian businessmen in a modern executive office seated across a dark wood desk. Foreground shows the back of one man in a checked navy suit (over-the-shoulder view); the main subject facing the camera is a smiling man in a navy suit and patterned tie, hands clasped as he speaks. Office features leather chairs, a desk pad with documents and a pen, a table lamp providing warm light, a glass partition with horizontal frosted stripes, and wood-paneled shelving with a framed photo and decorative items. The mood is professional, friendly, and confident with warm, even lighting and shallow depth of field that keeps focus on the conversing pair.
assets.useCase: Use as a mid-shot in a short reel to illustrate client consultations, job interviews, sales meetings, or executive discussions—works well as an establishing interview or cutaway during dialogue.

assets.title: Business Lunch Two Women Restaurant Portrait
assets.detailedDescription: Vertical, photorealistic medium-close shot of two professional women in business attire sharing a friendly lunch at a modern restaurant. Warm ambient lighting and hanging lamps illuminate their faces; one woman smiles while the other listens and gestures with a fork. On the wooden table are plates with salad and entrees, a glass of water, bread, and condiments; the background shows glass partitions and softly blurred diners, creating a candid corporate-meeting-over-meal atmosphere.
assets.useCase: B-roll or cutaway shot in short reels for employer branding, recruitment, corporate culture, networking, or client-meeting sequences; works as an opener or transition to convey approachable professionalism.

assets.title: Business Traveler Airport Dubai Departure
assets.detailedDescription: Vertical photoreal image of a smiling young woman in a black business suit walking through a modern airport terminal. She holds a passport/boarding pass in one hand, pulls a patterned carry-on with the other, and carries a black leather tote. A departures display above shows destination 'Dubai' and an Emirates flight code, while large windows provide soft natural side light. Background includes seated passengers, a crew member in uniform, reflective tiled floors and wooden ceiling beams, creating a candid, professional travel moment suited for commercial or corporate use.
assets.useCase: Establishing or B-roll shot in a short reel for corporate travel, airline promos, business lifestyle vlogs, or app onboarding sequences showing a professional arriving at departures.

assets.title: Business Traveler Woman Departure Dubai Boarding
assets.detailedDescription: Vertical photorealistic portrait of a smiling young professional woman walking through an airport terminal. She wears a black business suit, carries a black tote bag, and pulls a patterned rolling suitcase with one hand while holding a passport and boarding pass in the other. A departures display board behind her is legible, advertising a flight to Dubai (Emirates EK 568) and gate/boarding times. Background shows airport seating, other passengers slightly out of focus, large windows with natural light, and architectural ceiling details. The image captures a candid, confident travel moment suited for business and travel storytelling.
assets.useCase: Opening or transition shot in a short travel or corporate reel: business trip montage, airline/airport promo, travel vlog intro, or B-roll for articles about corporate travel and airports.

assets.title: Businesswoman Reading Grain Package At Supermarket Checkout
assets.detailedDescription: Vertical photorealistic image of a professionally dressed woman in a black suit standing at a supermarket checkout counter, holding and reading a sealed bag of grains. She looks focused on the product label while a cashier in a green uniform stands opposite her. Grocery items on the conveyor include a milk bottle, a clear bag of legumes, a large bottle of cooking oil, and snack packaging; a shopping cart with colorful chips is visible to the right. Background shelves of packaged goods are softly blurred with a visible green sign that reads an eco-friendly message. Warm ambient supermarket lighting, shallow depth of field, natural skin tones, and candid composition convey a realistic, consumer-focused moment.
assets.useCase: Mid-shot B-roll for a short reel about mindful shopping, product label reading, sustainable groceries, or a lifestyle segment showing a professional comparing ingredients at checkout.

assets.title: Coding Word Pattern Black White
assets.detailedDescription: High-contrast typographic texture showing densely repeated uppercase 'CODING' words in white on a solid black background. The layout forms tight horizontal rows of the same sans-serif word, creating a patterned, non-directional backdrop. A slightly larger, bolder instance of the word appears near the center, providing a subtle focal point while the surrounding repetition reads as a seamless texture. No colors other than black and white; flat, graphic look with strong readability and high contrast—ideal as a background layer, animated loop, or title card plate for tech and programming content.
assets.useCase: Serves as a short-reel background or plate for tech/programming videos—use as a loopable backdrop, animated parallax layer behind titles, lower-third/overlay texture, or as a track matte for reveal animations in intros and transitions.

assets.title: Colorful Layered Paper Watermark Mosaic
assets.detailedDescription: Square, abstract collage-style asset composed of stacked, torn-paper-like layers forming concentric wavy rings. The composition uses a bright pastel-to-neon palette (teal, coral/pink, mustard yellow, lavender, orange) with subtle drop shadows and paper texture to create depth. A small, repeating black watermark-style text is tiled across the surface, adding a high-contrast typographic pattern over the colorful layers. Overall feel is playful, modern, and handcrafted with clear center-focused geometry and even edge treatments.
assets.useCase: Looping or static reel background for upbeat lifestyle or creative content; ideal behind animated titles, product shots, thumbnails, or as a textured transition/overlay.

assets.title: Commuter Finds Wallet Train Platform
assets.detailedDescription: Photorealistic portrait-orientation photograph of a male commuter kneeling on a busy train platform to pick up a dark brown leather wallet from the textured station floor. The man wears a light checked button-down shirt and dark trousers, holding a black briefcase at his side; his face shows concern and concentration. The scene features strong foreground subject focus with a shallow depth of field that blurs the crowded commuters and a train in the background. Visible contextual details include tactile paving along the platform edge, an overhead digital departure board with orange text, and a large platform number sign. Natural, diffused station lighting and realistic textures (wallet leather, speckled floor, clothing fabric) give a candid, documentary mood.
assets.useCase: Cutaway or close-up shot in a short reel illustrating a commuter discovering or retrieving a lost wallet — ideal for scenes about lost-and-found, travel safety, banking/security, insurance claims, or urgency during a commute.

assets.title: Compact Typographic Tile Black On White
assets.detailedDescription: Square, high-resolution typographic texture made from dense, repeating small sans-serif words arranged in a tight grid. Pure monochrome (black text on white) with uniform spacing and no central subject, producing an all-over patterned surface that reads as texture at a distance and legible type up close. Clean edges and consistent repeat make it suitable for seamless tiling, cropped motion, or animated offsets.
assets.useCase: Use as a loopable background or tiled texture in short reels: behind title cards, as a textured overlay for captions and lower-thirds, subtle parallax/scroll transitions, or to add editorial/techno texture to motion graphics.

assets.title: Corporate Advisor Client Discussion
assets.detailedDescription: Vertical, photorealistic image of two professional men in a modern office engaged in a consultative conversation across a glossy wooden conference table. One man in a navy suit gestures with a pen toward printed charts and graphs on a clipboard while the other, in a light-blue rolled-sleeve shirt, listens attentively with a hand at his chin. Visible props include a laptop, printed analytics, a black notebook, a white coffee mug, warm backlit shelving with plants and decor, and a glass partition with soft cityscape bokeh in the background; warm overhead and natural light create clear reflections on the table.
assets.useCase: Vertical B-roll or hero clip for finance or advisory reels showing a client consultation, ideal for intros, service explainers, onboarding screens, or testimonial segments.

assets.title: Corporate Bank Waiting Area Man On Phone
assets.detailedDescription: Photoreal vertical shot of a modern corporate bank/financial services waiting area. In the foreground a seated man wearing a light pink shirt and dark trousers is looking at his smartphone on a beige sofa. Two other men in business shirts sit behind him, one with a contemplative pose; further back are customers at the service counter with staff behind a glass partition, a wall-mounted TV, and recessed warm lighting. The space features a glossy beige marble floor, wood-paneled accents, a long planter with green foliage along the right, and visible reflections in the glass. Overall mood is calm, professional, and candid with warm indoor lighting and natural window light.
assets.useCase: B-roll establishing shot for a short reel showing a bank or financial-services lobby — ideal for intro/transition scenes, customer experience segments, or background visuals for voiceover about service, queues, or corporate environments.

assets.title: Corporate Commute Glass Entrance Vertical
assets.detailedDescription: Vertical photorealistic shot of professionals entering and exiting a modern corporate building through a large glass facade. The composition features stone steps leading to full-height reflective windows and automatic glass doors, warm interior lighting contrasted with cooler exterior reflections of trees, and a mixed group of business-casual commuters in motion. Strong leading lines, depth, and symmetrical architecture make this suitable for B-roll, establishing, or transition shots in corporate and workplace videos.
assets.useCase: Use as an opening or transition B-roll shot for corporate reels, recruitment videos, office culture scenes, or commute/time-of-day transitions to set a professional workplace mood.

assets.title: Corporate Consultation Tablet Meeting
assets.detailedDescription: Vertical mid-shot of two professionals in a modern executive office during a one-on-one consultation. The advisor in a navy suit and tie is engaged, gesturing toward a tablet on a glossy marble desk while the other person (in a light-blue shirt) listens with hands near his face; papers, a leather folio and a glass of water sit on the table. Background shows warm LED-lit shelving with decorative objects and a large window providing cool daylight, creating a professional, collaborative atmosphere.
assets.useCase: Use as a mid-shot B-roll clip in corporate reels for client consultations, sales pitches, advisory services, onboarding sequences, or testimonial cutaways.

assets.title: Corporate Lobby Entrance Commuters
assets.detailedDescription: Vertical photo of a modern corporate building entrance with tall glass facade and wide steps. Multiple professionals in business-casual attire are walking up and down the stairs: men in button-down shirts and slacks, women in blouses and a green kurta. Warm interior lighting contrasts with cooler exterior light; large reflective glass panels show tree reflections and interior ceiling lights. Potted plants flank the doorway, creating a framed, symmetrical composition with visible depth from foreground pavement to interior corridor.
assets.useCase: Establishing B-roll or cutaway in a corporate reel showing employees arriving and departing an office building; works for intros, transitions, workplace culture or commute montages.

assets.title: Corporate Lunch Two Professional Women Portrait
assets.detailedDescription: Portrait-oriented photoreal image of two professional South Asian women in business attire sharing a friendly lunch at a modern restaurant. Foreground shows a woman in a gray blazer smiling directly at her colleague (wearing a black blazer and glasses) while holding a fork; plates with salad, bread, and mixed hot dishes, a glass of water and condiments sit on a wooden table. Warm pendant lighting, glass partition windows and softly blurred diners form the background, creating an intimate, professional atmosphere.
assets.useCase: B-roll or cutaway in a short corporate reel showing employee interaction — ideal for employer branding, recruitment, networking or team-culture sequences.

assets.title: Corporate Meeting Attentive Woman Vertical
assets.detailedDescription: Vertical close-up of a professional woman in a business suit taking notes during a boardroom meeting. She sits at a conference table with a laptop, notebook and pen, and a glass of water in the foreground. A large screen in the background displays blurred bar and pie charts; two colleagues sit softly out of focus behind her. The lighting is natural and even, colors are neutral with cool blue infographic accents, and the composition emphasizes her attentive, engaged expression.
assets.useCase: Cutaway close-up for a corporate reel: use as a reaction or B-roll shot during presentations, leadership profiles, training modules, or team meeting sequences.

assets.title: Corporate Reception Welcome Briefcase
assets.detailedDescription: Photorealistic vertical portrait of a modern corporate reception area. A well-dressed man in a light blue shirt and dark trousers stands with a black leather briefcase facing a smiling female receptionist seated behind a marble-and-wood counter labeled 'RECEPTION'. The background shows glass-walled offices and a walking colleague, plus a mounted motivational sign with blue and black text reading 'TEAMWORK, INNOVATION, EXCELLENCE, INTEGRITY'. Warm neutral indoor lighting, a small potted plant on the desk, and reflective marble flooring complete the scene. The composition emphasizes a front-facing interaction, professional tone, and clear corporate branding elements.
assets.useCase: Establishing or cutaway shot in a short corporate reel showing arrival, visitor check-in, or first-day onboarding at an office reception.

assets.title: Couple Gold Jewelry Store Consultation
assets.detailedDescription: Vertical photorealistic image of a couple consulting a jeweler at a glass-topped display counter. A large ornate gold necklace with matching earrings is presented on a dark velvet tray in the foreground; the couple leans in to examine it while the salesperson gestures toward the piece. Warm overhead spotlights and glass display cases filled with necklace busts and bangle rows create rich gold highlights and reflective accents. The woman wears an embroidered beige outfit and matching gold earrings; the man wears a light button-up shirt. Composition emphasizes the jewelry and facial expressions with shallow depth of field and a luxury retail atmosphere.
assets.useCase: B-roll or cutaway in a short reel for jewelry ecommerce or retail storytelling — ideal for product reveal, customer consultation, wedding shopping, or luxury store atmosphere shots.

assets.title: Customer Qr Payment Retail Checkout
assets.detailedDescription: Photorealistic mid-shot of a retail checkout where a smiling male customer uses his smartphone to scan a tabletop QR code for payment while a store cashier holds the clear QR display and stands behind a POS terminal. The scene includes paper shopping bags on the counter, a monitor, pens in a holder, and blurred store shelving and shoppers in the warm-lit background. The customer wears a navy button-up shirt; the cashier wears a light shirt with a dark apron. Shallow depth of field keeps focus on the phone, QR sign, and hands, with soft bokeh behind.
assets.useCase: Short reel or B-roll shot for fintech or retail ads demonstrating contactless QR payments at checkout, POS UX demos, or social videos about seamless in-store transactions.

assets.title: Dark Charcoal Grainy Typographic Pattern
assets.detailedDescription: A moody, dark charcoal background texture featuring a repeating, stamped typographic pattern across the frame. The surface has heavy film grain, subtle scratches and worn edges with a low-contrast, desaturated gray palette and a faint vignette toward corners. The repeating words are faintly embossed/printed to create a patterned backdrop rather than a readable headline — suitable as a gritty, atmospheric plate for overlays and text treatments.
assets.useCase: Use as an atmospheric background plate in short reels for title cards, lower thirds, transitions, or as a textured overlay behind UI/graphics to add grit and mood.

assets.title: Delhi Airport Terminal Signage Portrait
assets.detailedDescription: Vertical photorealistic photo of a busy modern airport terminal taken from a central aisle perspective. Prominent overhead directional sign (yellow on black) indicates "Gates 1-26", "Lounges" and "Toilets" with icons and Hindi translations. Long vanishing point framed by a curved ceiling and glass curtain walls, polished reflective floor, retail signs (WHSmith, The Square) and crowds of passengers pulling rolling luggage. Neutral daylight, high contrast signage, and clear depth make this ideal as an establishing travel shot.
assets.useCase: Vertical establishing shot for travel reels, social-story transitions, airport arrival/departure sequences, or corporate travel B-roll; works as foreground/background layer for title cards or motion graphics.

assets.title: Dense Typographic Noise Tile
assets.detailedDescription: High-contrast monochrome texture made from tightly repeated typographic elements forming a dense, grid-like pattern. The asset is primarily black text or glyph-like marks on a white field, creating a busy, noisy surface with consistent spacing and alignment. It reads as an abstract patterned background rather than legible copy; edges and repetition make it suitable for seamless tiling, overlays, or masked reveals. The overall look is graphic, minimal in color, and strong in contrast, producing a crisp, modern visual texture.
assets.useCase: Use as a fast-moving or static background in short reels behind titles, lower-thirds, or product shots; apply as an overlay for masked reveals, glitch transitions, or to add a gritty typographic texture to tech/data segments.

assets.title: Dense Typographic Texture Bw
assets.detailedDescription: Square (1:1) black-and-white typographic texture composed of densely repeated sans-serif text blocks arranged in a regular grid. The copy is tightly tracked with short line height so the repeated words form a high-frequency, rhythmic pattern rather than a single readable paragraph. Strong black type on a white background creates a high-contrast, modern, minimal look that reads as a graphic surface from typical viewing distances. Works well as a seamless-tileable background or layered overlay; responds well to subtle pans, zooms, color grading, and motion blur for kinetic edits.
assets.useCase: Use as a looping background or animated texture in short reel shots — pan or parallax with color overlay for title cards, transitions, lower-thirds backplates, or to add rhythmic typographic motion behind product or interview clips.

assets.title: Desk Financial Reports Calculator Pen
assets.detailedDescription: Portrait-oriented close-up of a wooden office desk with stacked financial reports and charts in focus. A silver metal pen rests on top of printed pages showing bar charts and a pie chart. A calculator sits in the foreground to the right, slightly out of focus. Background contains a softly blurred desk lamp, a small green potted plant and a pen holder, creating warm, moody lighting and shallow depth-of-field bokeh. Composition emphasizes the paperwork and pen as the primary subject, conveying accounting, bookkeeping, or financial analysis activity.
assets.useCase: Short reel B-roll or cutaway for finance/accounting videos — use as a transition or overlay when discussing reports, analytics, bookkeeping, tax season, or financial planning.

assets.title: Desk Financial Reports Pen Calculator Vertical
assets.detailedDescription: Vertical close-up photo of a wooden office desk covered with stacked financial reports and printed charts, a metal pen resting on top, and a calculator in the foreground. Background shows soft bokeh with a lit desk lamp, a pen cup and a small potted plant, creating a warm, focused workspace atmosphere. Shallow depth of field emphasizes paperwork texture and chart details while keeping the surrounding office elements softly blurred.
assets.useCase: Use as a short reel B-roll or insert shot to illustrate accounting, financial analysis, reporting, bookkeeping, or budgeting scenes — ideal for transitions, overlays, or voiceover segments.

assets.title: Dubai Al Rigga Bed Space Street Sign Portrait
assets.detailedDescription: Vertical photorealistic street photo showing a young traveler with backpack and wheeled suitcase looking up at a cluster of large rental signs reading 'BED SPACE AVAILABLE FOR BOYS' on a busy Dubai sidewalk. The right side of the frame is dominated by stacked advertising boards listing amenities (free WiFi, free DEWA, free gas, clean rooms, 24/7 security, near metro) and a prominent phone number; a subway/wayfinding sign for Al Rigga and a distant high-rise skyline including the city's tallest tower occupy the left and background. Warm daytime light, pedestrians and cars on the road create an active urban travel atmosphere. Composition emphasizes vertical signage contrast (blue, yellow, red) against the pale sky and dense city buildings.
assets.useCase: Establishing or B‑roll shot in a short reel about travel arrivals, low-cost rentals, student/worker housing, city relocation tips, or urban wayfinding; works as a cutaway while narrating rental options or cost-of-living in Dubai.

assets.title: Elderly Man Black Turban Beard Portrait
assets.detailedDescription: High-resolution, head-and-shoulders photorealistic portrait of an elderly man wearing a black turban and layered traditional robes. The subject has a full white beard, thin framed glasses, and a composed, slightly smiling expression. Lighting is soft and even with subtle warm highlights on the face, set against a smooth vertical gradient background that shifts from warm beige to muted taupe. Textures are finely detailed in the beard and fabric, while the backdrop is deliberately blurred to keep focus on the face.
assets.useCase: Use as a close-up profile or cutaway shot in short reels for news, documentary, or educational segments discussing religious leadership, cultural topics, or political context; suitable for intro frames, lower-third overlays, or slow push-in shots.

assets.title: Embossed Globe Travel Seal
assets.detailedDescription: A circular, embossed seal-style emblem with a central globe motif showing latitude/longitude grid lines. The design has multiple concentric rings and ridged edges, with repeated stamped text around the inner ring (appearing as a vintage passport or travel stamp). The artwork uses a muted, earthy palette—beiges, olive greens and warm browns—with distressed, paper-like texture and subtle shadowing to emphasize the 3D, pressed-metal/embossed look. Ideal as a decorative overlay, logo lockup, or transition badge in travel, logistics, sustainability or exploration-themed video reels.
assets.useCase: Short reel shot as an intro/outro badge or overlay for travel, sustainability, or logistics segments—appears center-screen for 1–3 seconds while title text animates in, or used as a corner watermark during montage transitions.

assets.title: Employee Rupee Bonus Celebration
assets.detailedDescription: Vertical photorealistic office scene showing a young male employee seated at a desk, holding two large fanned stacks of Indian rupee notes with an ecstatic expression. Four coworkers stand behind him in a glass-partitioned meeting room, smiling and clapping in celebration. The desk foreground includes a smartphone, printed charts, and a laptop partially visible. Warm overhead office lighting and shallow depth of field keep the focus on the subject while the colleagues and glass walls form a softly blurred corporate background.
assets.useCase: Mid-shot reveal in a short reel for topics like bonus announcements, payroll/payday, sales commission wins, startup funding celebrations, or promotional thumbnails showing employee rewards and financial success.

assets.title: Exam Crowd Outside Exam Center
assets.detailedDescription: High-density, photorealistic vertical portrait shot of thousands of young adults queuing and moving toward a large institutional building entrance. Foreground shows tightly framed individuals holding exam papers and backpacks, midground reveals organized lines with visible security/personnel in khaki uniforms, and background shows the building facade and distant trees. Natural daylight with slightly overcast sky produces even, muted lighting and saturated but restrained colors. Composition uses an elevated vantage and leading lines (stairs, railings, crowd flow) to emphasize scale and crowd movement; mood is serious, focused, and slightly tense—typical of exam day or mass recruitment events.
assets.useCase: Establishing or b-roll shot in a short reel to illustrate exam day, mass recruitment, entrance lines, overcrowding, or campus events — useful for transitions, news segments, documentaries, or educational/HR videos.

assets.title: Executive Consultation Office Tablet
assets.detailedDescription: Vertical photorealistic image of a professional office consultation: two male professionals seated across a polished dark marble desk, one in a navy suit and tie leaning forward and gesturing with an open hand while referencing a tablet propped in a folio. Warm built-in shelf lighting and decorative objects sit behind them on the left, while a tall window with city light softly illuminates the right, creating a contrast of warm interior and cool daylight. Documents, a notebook, and a glass of water are visible on the desk; the composition emphasizes the consultant's friendly, confident expression and hand gesture, with shallow depth of field and reflective surface details.
assets.useCase: Mid-to-close shot for a short reel showing a consultant or advisor explaining a proposal—ideal for B-roll, service promos, onboarding sequences, or testimonial overlays where voiceover or text explains offerings.

assets.title: Family Buying Plot 25
assets.detailedDescription: Vertical photorealistic image of a family meeting a real estate agent on an undeveloped plot of land. Four people — two parents and a young daughter standing next to a suited agent — smile while reviewing documents in a tan folder. In the foreground a red-and-white "LAND FOR SALE" sign is planted in the soil and a concrete plot marker reads "PLOT NO. 25" with the number 25 painted red. The setting is an open, cleared brown field under a clear blue sky; lighting is warm midday sun, creating natural, high-contrast colors and soft shadows. Composition emphasizes the group interaction and the prominent sale signage/plot marker to communicate an on-site property purchase or site visit.
assets.useCase: Use as a B-roll or establishing shot in a short real estate reel: family site visit, property listing promo, customer testimonial intro, or ad segment emphasizing trust and on-site purchase for a residential plot.

assets.title: Family Consultation Two Children Financial Advisor Office
assets.detailedDescription: Photorealistic corporate scene of a family of four (two parents and two children) seated across a light wood desk from a male advisor in a dark suit. The advisor is holding a pen and gesturing over an open folder of documents and forms on the desk. The family leans in attentively with warm, engaged expressions. Background shows a modern office interior with glass partitions, horizontal frosted stripes, pendant lights, and an orange accent wall with a framed poster. A small potted plant sits in the foreground on the desk. The framing is a mid-shot from slightly above desk level, even warm lighting, shallow depth of field that keeps faces and documents in focus while softly blurring the background.
assets.useCase: B-roll or primary shot for short reels about family financial planning, mortgage or insurance consultations, bank/credit union ads, or explainer videos about household budgeting — works as an establishing or cutaway to show client-advisor interaction.

assets.title: Family Reviewing Blueprints Construction Site
assets.detailedDescription: Vertical portrait of a smiling family of four (two adults, two children) standing in the foreground of an active building site. The parents hold and review large architectural blueprints while the children look on excitedly. Behind them, a partially constructed concrete and brick structure with exposed rebar, scaffolding, ladders and several construction workers wearing hard hats and an orange safety vest is visible. A ground-mounted signboard in the lower-right reads "OUR DREAM HOME - CONSTRUCTION STARTED" with a line drawing of a house. The scene is shot in natural daylight on dusty, earth-toned ground; composition emphasizes the family and the blueprint as focal points with the construction activity providing contextual depth.
assets.useCase: Mid- or opening-shot for a real-estate or homebuilder reel showing a family reviewing plans at a construction site to convey progress, trust, and emotional payoff.

assets.title: Family Selecting Gold Necklace In Jewelry Store
assets.detailedDescription: Portrait-oriented photorealistic image of a South Asian family inside a luxury jewelry boutique. A young man in an embroidered kurta holds an ornate, traditional gold bridal necklace up for inspection while a smiling woman in a silk saree and gold jewelry looks on; two older relatives stand behind them, pleased. Illuminated glass display cases and velvet necklace trays filled with heavy gold sets fill the foreground and background. Warm, golden ambient lighting and shallow depth of field emphasize the intricate necklace details and the celebratory, intimate mood.
assets.useCase: Use as a hero or B-roll shot in short reels for jewelry ads, wedding shopping scenes, cultural celebration promos, or e-commerce product highlight transitions focusing on bridal gold pieces.

assets.title: Family Testing Beige Sofa Showroom
assets.detailedDescription: Vertical photorealistic image of a family of four (two adults and two children) sitting and leaning on a beige sectional sofa inside a well-lit furniture showroom. The family is smiling and touching the sofa cushion to test comfort; the composition centers on tactile interaction and warm, neutral upholstery. Background shows display lighting, pendant lamps, other furniture pieces and a visible showroom sign with the words 'Comfort Style Quality,' creating a retail environment context. Soft, even lighting, shallow depth of field on the family and sofa, and muted color palette emphasize texture and lifestyle appeal.
assets.useCase: Mid-shot B-roll for a furniture store promo or ecommerce reel showing a family testing a sofa to highlight comfort, texture and lifestyle appeal; works as a cutaway or hero segment in social ads and product pages.

assets.title: Family Village Walk Rural India
assets.detailedDescription: Vertical photorealistic image of a four-person family (two parents and two children) walking together along a dirt path in a rural village. The family wears modern, light-colored casual clothing and white sneakers; the adults wear sunglasses. They are smiling and looking slightly off-camera, captured mid-step in a candid, natural moment. Background shows traditional thatched-roof huts, hanging woven baskets, a cow at left, seated local elders in traditional dress in the foreground, and tree-covered hills in soft focus. Warm natural daylight and shallow depth of field produce soft background blur while keeping the family sharply in focus. Composition is full-body, eye-level, and optimized for tall/vertical formats.
assets.useCase: Establishing B-roll or hero shot for a short reel about family travel, cultural visits, lifestyle brand storytelling, or NGO/community outreach; works well as an opening or transition vertical clip.

assets.title: Female Bank Advisor Explaining Docs To Client
assets.detailedDescription: Vertical, photorealistic office scene showing a female financial advisor in a navy blazer and white shirt sitting across a desk from a male client in a light-blue shirt. The advisor holds a pen and gestures to printed documents on a clipboard while the client follows along; a computer monitor, marble countertop and warm wood-paneled background frame the interaction. The shot is mid-close, framed to emphasize the consultative exchange and paperwork, with soft background blur and natural warm lighting for a professional, trustworthy mood.
assets.useCase: Short reel mid-shot or b-roll for banking and finance videos showing an advisor explaining forms — ideal for onboarding, customer service, loan or account opening scenes and transitions.

assets.title: Young Traveler Checking Pg Rooms Signs
assets.detailedDescription: Vertical photoreal image of a young male traveler standing on a busy city sidewalk at golden hour, holding a smartphone and the handle of a carry-on suitcase while looking up at multiple stacked 'PG' / boarding-house signs mounted on a building. Foreground subject is left-of-center, wearing a backpack and casual jacket; midground shows a freestanding sandwich-board sign with bold navy, yellow and white text listing amenities; background contains a row of multi-story buildings, pedestrians and vehicles creating depth. Warm, directional sunlight casts soft shadows and emphasizes textures of the pavement and building facades; signage text is largely legible (including a visible contact number, not transcribed here). Composition uses leading lines from the sidewalk and vertical sign placement to draw the eye upward toward the signs.
assets.useCase: Cut or insert for a short reel showing a traveler or student searching for accommodation — works as an establishing shot for housing-search, travel-vlog, relocation, or urban exploration sequences.

assets.title: Client Advisor Consultation Orange Office
assets.detailedDescription: Photorealistic office scene showing a two-person consultation at a wooden desk. Framed medium-shot, camera slightly above table level, focused on the interaction: a seated advisor on the right (navy blazer) pointing with a pen to a printed brochure or form in a black portfolio while a seated client on the left (beige shirt) listens and smiles. Background features a frosted glass partition with horizontal stripes, warm overhead lighting and an orange accent wall with framed signage. Desk foreground includes a small potted plant, mesh pen holder with pens, a closed black tablet or folio, and a circular cable grommet. Natural, warm color grading and shallow depth of field keep the subjects crisp while softly blurring the office background.
assets.useCase: B-roll or cutaway shot in a short reel showing a customer onboarding, client consultation, bank or financial advisory meeting — ideal for transitions when explaining services, paperwork review, or relationship-building moments.

assets.title: Dense Typographic Glyph Pattern
assets.detailedDescription: High-contrast black-on-white seamless texture made from tightly packed, repeating typographic glyphs. The composition reads as regular vertical rhythm—columns of small monospaced characters create a barcode-like, data-driven surface. The pattern is abstract and non-directional at a glance but reveals typographic detail up close, making it suitable as a subtle yet tactile backdrop for motion graphics, title plates, or tech-themed overlays.
assets.useCase: Use as a looping background or masked reveal in short reels—ideal for tech/data sequences, title or credit cards, and rhythmic transitions where a patterned, typographic surface adds visual texture without distracting from foreground content.

assets.title: Older Man Trying Glasses In Optical Mirror
assets.detailedDescription: Photorealistic vertical portrait of an older man with white hair and a mustache trying on a pair of eyeglasses in an optical store. He smiles as he adjusts the frame while holding a handheld mirror; an optician is partially visible in the foreground holding the mirror. Glass shelves filled with multiple eyeglass frames form a softly lit background with warm, ambient lighting and shallow depth of field. The composition emphasizes the subject's face, the glasses' fit, and the mirror reflection, delivering a candid, positive moment during a frame fitting.
assets.useCase: Use as a short reel shot for eyewear store promos, hearing/vision care clinic testimonials, product-fit demonstrations, appointment booking CTAs, or lifestyle scenes showing satisfied customers during an optical fitting.

assets.title: Financial Advisor Client Consultation Office
assets.detailedDescription: Photorealistic vertical mid-shot of a professional financial advisor in a navy suit and blue tie talking to a seated client across a dark wood desk. The advisor gestures with a pen above printed charts on a clipboard while an open laptop, stacked notebooks and a black coffee mug sit on the desk; warm vertical LED shelf lighting and a table lamp create a cozy, high-end office atmosphere with shallow depth of field.
assets.useCase: Short reel mid-shot or cutaway for a financial-services video: ideal for scenes about client consultations, advisory meetings, onboarding, loan approvals or trust-building brand moments.

assets.title: Financial Advisor Client Meeting Office
assets.detailedDescription: Photorealistic vertical portrait of a professional consultation in a modern office. A well-dressed advisor in a navy suit and tie sits behind a wooden desk, gesturing with a pen while speaking to a seated client (seen from behind). On the desk are an open laptop, printed charts and reports, a clipboard, a black coffee mug and stacked notebooks. Warm ambient lighting and a softly lit bookshelf with decorative objects form the background, creating a focused yet approachable business atmosphere.
assets.useCase: 3–6 second reel shot to establish a professional client-advisor consultation — useful as an intro or cutaway in financial services promos, onboarding videos, client testimonial sequences, or corporate training content.

assets.title: Financial Advisor Senior Client Consultation
assets.detailedDescription: Photorealistic vertical portrait of a smiling female financial advisor and an older male client seated at a desk in a modern office. The advisor, wearing a navy blazer and patterned scarf, points to documents with a pen while the client in a beige shirt follows along. On the desk are printed forms, a closed laptop, a pen cup, and a small potted plant. Background shows a glass partition with frosted stripes, warm pendant lights out of focus, and an orange-accented poster on the wall. The interaction feels collaborative, professional, and reassuring.
assets.useCase: Close-up reel shot for banking/finance promos or onboarding sequences showing a trusted advisor explaining paperwork to a senior client (suitable for website hero shots, ad banners, or app intro scenes).

assets.title: Foggy Lake Park Bench Lamppost Night
assets.detailedDescription: Vertical, photorealistic night scene of an empty wooden park bench under a single curved lamppost beside a foggy lake. Warm amber light from the lamp casts a focused cone onto wet cobblestone and fallen leaves, creating strong reflections on the rain-slick path. Large tree silhouettes frame the left side, their bare branches and scattered leaves adding texture. The midground shows mist over the water and soft bokeh of distant city lights across the lake. Overall palette is deep navy and charcoal blues with a single warm light accent, producing a moody, contemplative atmosphere suitable for cinematic or atmospheric backgrounds.
assets.useCase: Use as an establishing or transition shot in a short reel: slow push-in or parallax over the empty bench for a moody intro, background for title/text overlays, or B-roll for contemplative storytelling.

assets.title: Formal Politician Portrait Red Tie
assets.detailedDescription: Studio-style head-and-shoulders portrait of an older Caucasian male in a dark navy suit and white shirt, wearing a bright red silk tie and a small flag lapel pin. The image is photorealistic with smooth, slightly airbrushed skin retouching, warm even lighting, and a soft peach-to-coral gradient background with a subtle vignette. The subject faces forward with a neutral, confident expression. High resolution, centered composition, suitable for editorial or promotional use without background distractions.
assets.useCase: Use as a close-up hero or cutaway in short political or news reels, campaign-style promos, documentary lower-thirds, or transition shots where a formal leader portrait is needed.

assets.title: Four Delivery Riders Zomato Swiggy Zepto Blinkit Backview
assets.detailedDescription: Photographic back-view of four delivery motorbike riders lined side-by-side on a city street. Each rider wears a branded uniform and insulated delivery bag: red (Zomato), orange (Swiggy) with a helmet, purple (Zepto), and yellow (Blinkit). The composition is vertically oriented with the riders occupying the lower two-thirds of the frame and a tree-lined urban avenue with blurred residential buildings filling the background. Faces are not visible; emphasis is on the contrasting brand colors, logos on shirts and bags, and the motorcycles' taillights and wheels. Natural daylight with soft shadows and shallow depth of field produce a crisp foreground and creamy bokeh background.
assets.useCase: Ideal as an opening or transition shot in a short reel to highlight competing delivery services — use for app promos, comparison segments, onboarding screens, or social ads with logo overlays and lower-third text.

assets.title: Gold Buyback Jewelry Counter Cash Calculator
assets.detailedDescription: Vertical photorealistic shot of a smiling female customer at a jewelry store counter holding an ornate gold necklace while a shop attendant presents a stack of Indian rupee notes and a calculator displaying a high buyback price (₹1,85,750). The background shows glass display cases filled with necklaces, bangles and gold ornaments and a black-and-gold sign reading 'GOLD PRICE AT RECORD HIGH — SELL TODAY GET BEST VALUE'. Warm, polished gold tones, shallow depth of field and reflective store lighting create a luxurious, festive atmosphere. Composition emphasizes the hands, jewelry details, currency and the price display — optimized for vertical social reels or advertising cuts.
assets.useCase: Hero vertical clip for a short reel or ad about gold prices, buyback offers or selling jewelry — fits transition shots, product hero frames, or thumbnails emphasizing value and trust.

assets.title: Gold Necklace Sales Interaction Vertical
assets.detailedDescription: Vertical photorealistic portrait of an in-store jewelry sales interaction: a smiling saleswoman holds up an ornate gold necklace across the counter while a seated customer uses a calculator to total the purchase. The foreground shows trays with additional gold necklaces, a stack of cash, and a calculator; the midground focuses on the salesperson and the necklace she displays; the background features backlit glass display cases filled with gold necklace busts. Warm, high-key golden lighting, rich yellow-gold tones and shallow depth of field create a luxurious, intimate retail atmosphere.
assets.useCase: Short reel shot for retail or commerce sequences: product reveal and purchase moment, B-roll for jewelry store promos, luxury shopping lifestyle scenes, or explanatory cutaways in commerce/finance videos.

assets.title: Hand Holding 500 Inr Notes Office Desk
assets.detailedDescription: Vertical close-up photograph of a hand fanning multiple Indian ₹500 banknotes (Reserve Bank of India, older Mahatma Gandhi series) held above a wooden office desk. Background shows a black computer keyboard and partially visible paperwork. The image has natural indoor lighting, shallow depth of field, crisp detail on currency texture and printed elements, and a candid, mid-frame composition with the thumb and fingers visible in the foreground.
assets.useCase: Use as a mid-close reveal shot in a short reel to illustrate cash payouts, salary or bonus distribution, expense reimbursement, or a personal finance moment; works well as a transition or cut-in to emphasize money or transaction.

assets.title: Hand Holding 500 Rupee Notes Office Desk
assets.detailedDescription: Vertical photorealistic close-up of a right hand fanning a stack of Indian 500-rupee banknotes. The thumb and fingers are visible in the foreground holding the notes; the notes show the denomination numerals and 'Reserve Bank of India' text. Background elements include a wooden desk surface, a black computer keyboard, and paperwork with blue-ink signatures. Natural indoor lighting and a shallow depth of field put emphasis on the cash while soft-blurring the office background.
assets.useCase: Short-reel close-up b-roll for salary/payday, cash payout, loan or salary disbursement, small-business cash transaction, personal finance tips, or call-to-action emphasizing physical money in an office setting.

assets.title: Hand Holding Indian Pan Card
assets.detailedDescription: Close-up photorealistic shot of a right hand holding an Indian Permanent Account Number (PAN) card horizontally against a soft off-white to pale gradient background. The rectangular plastic card is blue-toned with rounded corners, bilingual Hindi/English labels, a small government emblem at the top, a square QR-like security pattern on the right, a placeholder avatar illustration on the left, and masked/sample alphanumeric PAN and name lines. The card is pinched between the thumb and index finger with other fingers visible behind; skin texture and natural fingernail detail are visible. Even studio lighting produces soft highlights on the card surface and a shallow depth of field keeps the hand and card sharp while the background remains smooth and unobtrusive.
assets.useCase: Short reel insert or B-roll: use as a cutaway when discussing tax registration, KYC/identity verification, financial onboarding, government services, or as a visual overlay while narrating instructions about PAN-related processes.

assets.title: Hopeful Actor Bollywood Casting Call
assets.detailedDescription: Vertical photorealistic portrait of a young man smiling upward with a hopeful expression in front of a Bollywood arch and a large 'Casting Call' poster. He wears a worn, dusty button-up shirt and carries a shoulder bag; warm golden sunlight rim-lights his face and hair. Background shows a blurred crowd and a movie billboard, giving a cinematic, gritty-aspirational atmosphere.
assets.useCase: Cutaway or establishing shot in a short reel showing an aspiring actor arriving at auditions — ideal for audition montages, origin-story beats, or inspirational career sequences.

assets.title: Indian Couple Gold Jewellery Shopping Showcase
assets.detailedDescription: Vertical, photorealistic retail scene of a young Indian couple consulting a jeweller over an ornate gold necklace inside a luxury jewelry store. The woman wears a champagne-gold embroidered saree and layered traditional gold jewelry; the man wears a matching kurta. A salesperson, seen from behind, holds a heavy, filigree gold necklace above velvet-lined trays filled with matching choker sets, bangles and earrings. Warm, golden display lighting, glass cases and mirrored backs emphasize reflections and metallic shine; textures include polished gold, velvet trays, carved wood and embroidered fabric. Composition focuses on the couple's engaged expressions and the detailed craftsmanship of the jewelry in the foreground.
assets.useCase: B-roll or hero shot in a short reel for wedding jewelry ads, retail e-commerce landing clips, social media product closeups, or lifestyle storytelling about bridal shopping and purchase decisions.

assets.title: Innovate Job Offer Unboxing Reveal
assets.detailedDescription: Vertical portrait photograph of a young woman in a home office happily reading a printed 'JOB OFFER LETTER' while pumping her fist. In the foreground is a branded onboarding kit with black packaging labeled 'Innovate' (includes over-ear headphones, a smartphone, notebook, travel tumbler, box of chocolates and a tote bag reading 'Welcome to the team!'), and a laptop with the same logo. Soft, warm natural lighting, neutral beige background with minimal decor. Composition emphasizes candid emotional reaction plus a clear view of the branded welcome items.
assets.useCase: Mid-shot reveal in a short recruiting or onboarding reel: candidate opens offer, reacts with joy, then cut to branded welcome kit and product close-ups for careers page or social ad.

assets.title: Iphone15pro Unboxing Customer Reaction
assets.detailedDescription: Vertical portrait photo of a retail store moment: a smiling sales associate hands a boxed iPhone to an ecstatic young woman while her companion celebrates. The composition centers on the boxed smartphone being handed over, with an Apple store-style illuminated product billboard in the background reading 'iPhone 15 Pro.' Visible foreground elements include a white shopping bag with a logo, an open product box, and two demo phones displayed on a wooden countertop. Warm, even retail lighting, shallow depth of field, and candid emotional expressions give the image a lively, authentic shopping atmosphere.
assets.useCase: Cut-in shot for a short reel showing the joyful moment of receiving a newly purchased phone at a retail launch or promotional montage highlighting customer experience and unboxing.

assets.title: Irani Firoza Turquoise Inspection Desk
assets.detailedDescription: Photorealistic vertical shot of a gemologist at his desk closely inspecting a sky-blue Irani Firoza (Iranian turquoise) cabochon with a jeweler's loupe. The scene includes a tray of polished turquoise stones, scattered individual cabochons, a rough turquoise matrix, a digital scale, a framed RohiGems sign and certificate, a laptop with brand logo, a handwritten 'Today's Deals' notebook, a glass of tea, and Iranian cultural elements (flag, Persian calligraphy and a mosque visible through a window). Warm wood shelving, gold accents and rich studio lighting create a luxurious, authentic retail atmosphere focused on gemstone quality and provenance.
assets.useCase: B-roll close-up for a short product reel: quality inspection and provenance shot for gemstone ecommerce, brand promo, or an origin story segment highlighting Iranian turquoise and certification.

assets.title: Isometric Neon Delivery Tracker
assets.detailedDescription: A stylized 3D isometric night-time city diorama showing multiple last-mile delivery scooters following glowing, color-coded routes (orange, green, blue, purple) through wet reflective streets. Buildings (Foodie, Fuel coffee, Daily Mart, Tech Hub, City Clinic) are lit with warm interior lights and streetlamps; small pedestrians and street trees populate sidewalks. Floating order callouts above riders show order IDs, distances and statuses, while a semi-transparent ‘Live Delivery Tracker’ UI card in the lower-right lists order statuses and color legend. The scene emphasizes motion with arrowed path markers, neon trails, and a cinematic depth-of-field.
assets.useCase: Short reel shot for product demos or app promos: visualize last-mile delivery, live tracking features, route optimization, fleet management dashboards, or smart-city logistics in an engaging cinematic intro/transition.

assets.title: Jaipur Gemologist Ruby Inspection Table
assets.detailedDescription: Vertical photorealistic image of a gemologist at a desk inspecting a faceted red/pink gemstone with a jeweler's loupe. The table is organized with white trays of multicolored loose gemstones, a tray of finished rings, tweezers, a precision scale, and a framed sign reading '100% NATURAL GEMSTONES JAIPUR RAJASTHAN'. A branded certificate and pen sit in the foreground. Through the window behind him are distinctive Jaipur sandstone buildings and a fort, and a black wall sign that reads 'GEMSTONE BUSINESS JAIPUR' is visible to the left. Warm, studio-like lighting, shallow depth of field on the subject's hands and gem, high detail and rich color saturation.
assets.useCase: Close-up B-roll or hero shot for a short reel showcasing gemstone authentication, artisanal jewelry sourcing, 'Made in Jaipur' brand story, ecommerce product validation, or certification sequences.

assets.title: Jobs In Dubai Career Signboard
assets.detailedDescription: Vertical photorealistic street photo showing two young professionals (business attire) standing on a waterfront promenade in Dubai, looking up at a large recruitment sign that reads 'JOBS IN DUBAI' and lists corporate sectors and an apply email. The sign is navy, white and gold with bold typography and a secondary A-frame board in front advertising walk-in interviews and benefits. In the background is the Dubai skyline with the Burj Khalifa visible, palm trees, modern high-rise facades and light pedestrian activity. Daytime natural light, shallow depth of field keeps the sign and the pair in sharp focus while the skyline is slightly softened.
assets.useCase: Establishing or mid-shot in a short recruitment/relocation reel — shows local job opportunity signage and candidates, useful for transitions, call-to-action overlays, or opening scenes for career/hiring videos.

assets.title: Kr Market Bengaluru Bus Station Ksrtc Crowd
assets.detailedDescription: Vertical photorealistic photograph of K.R. Market KSRTC bus station in Bengaluru. Foreground shows two KSRTC buses (white-blue and red) parked at bays with passengers boarding and walking across the forecourt. Overhead large blue bilingual signboard (English and Kannada) reads 'Karnataka State Road Transport Corporation - Bengaluru Central Division'. Covered platforms with bay numbers (14, 15, 18) and a dense crowd of commuters with backpacks, bags and traditional clothing create a busy urban transit scene. Midground and background include multiple buses, urban buildings and signage under an overcast sky. Natural lighting, candid documentary feel, medium depth of field, accurate color rendering.
assets.useCase: Vertical establishing B‑roll for short reels about public transport, commuting, urban life or government transit services; works as a transition, background plate, or scene-setter for stories about Bengaluru or bus travel.

assets.title: Lofi Girl Coffee Rain Cafe Laptop
assets.detailedDescription: Vertical illustrated scene of a young woman in a cozy cafe working on a laptop during a rainy afternoon. The composition shows her in a warm oversized sweater seated at a wooden table with a latte (heart latte art), a green notebook labeled 'FOCUS PLAN GROW', a small vase of baby's breath, and a sticky note reading 'one day at a time'. Outside the large window, raindrops blur a streetlamp and a coffee shop across the road; a handwritten message on the glass reads 'Take it Easy'. Interior details include a hanging black pendant lamp, a small shelf with a plant and framed print, and a chalkboard with the words 'coffee rain lofi you'. Soft, muted warm tones and gentle lighting create a calm, introspective mood.
assets.useCase: Opening or B-roll shot for study-with-me, remote work, productivity, or cozy lifestyle reels — works as a vertical hero frame for short videos promoting focus, calm, or lofi playlists.

assets.title: Lofi Night Study Desk
assets.detailedDescription: Vertical illustrated study desk scene at night lit by a warm desk lamp. A tablet in the center plays a LOFI study video; open notebooks and loose sheets show checked study lists and handwritten equations. Sticky notes with motivational messages ("You got this!", "Believe in your Future", "Focus Mode") are taped to the wall and desk; a digital clock reads 12:00 AM. Stacked textbooks labeled PHYSICS, CHEMISTRY, MATHEMATICS, a potted plant, a mug reading "Just keep going", a small rabbit toy, pens, and a candy bar complete the tidy study setup. The window reveals a cool-blue city night, creating contrast with the amber indoor light; composition is portrait-oriented and highly detailed, optimized for mobile reels and social short formats.
assets.useCase: Cut-in or full-frame shot for a study-motivation reel or app promo: ideal as an opening/closing scene or background for overlay text (study tips, countdowns, reminders) in short-form vertical videos.

assets.title: Luxury Bank Lobby Marble Floor
assets.detailedDescription: Vertical photorealistic photograph of a high-end bank or corporate reception lobby. The composition shows a long row of wooden teller/reception desks with monitors and beige swivel chairs, large polished marble floor with strong reflections, tall stone-clad columns, frosted glass partitions, potted plants in metal planters, and a high ceiling with recessed and cove lighting. Warm neutral color palette (beige, cream, warm wood tones) and an airy, professional atmosphere. Clean, uncluttered space with strong perspective lines leading toward the back of the lobby.
assets.useCase: Establishing or cutaway shot in a short reel for financial services, corporate onboarding, customer service scenes, or upscale hospitality backgrounds where a polished bank lobby is needed.

assets.title: Magenta Typographic Seamless Texture
assets.detailedDescription: Seamless tiled texture composed of densely repeated bold sans-serif text in white over a vivid magenta/pink background. The typographic lines are tightly stacked with consistent horizontal alignment and minimal leading, creating an almost patterned, abstract surface rather than legible copy at a distance. The asset includes subtle film-like grain and slight edge softness that adds depth and prevents a digital-flat look. High contrast between the white type and saturated magenta gives the image an energetic, modern feel suitable as a backdrop or motion loop.
assets.useCase: Serves as a dynamic backdrop or looping surface for short-form reels, title cards, overlays, transitions, and promotional social videos where a bold, modern typographic texture is needed without legible copy.

assets.title: Man Inserting Card Atm Portrait View
assets.detailedDescription: Vertical photorealistic image of an adult man in a light blue dress shirt and dark trousers using an indoor ATM. Shot from behind and slightly to the left, showing the man's back and left profile as he inserts a bank card into the illuminated card reader. The ATM is modern, dark gray with a touchscreen, side selector buttons, numeric keypad, and cash slot. Background is softly blurred glass office/bank interior with cool, neutral tones. Face is not fully visible; focus is on the interaction with the machine and the card entry point.
assets.useCase: Cut-in shot for a short reel showing the moment of a bank transaction — ideal for sequences about ATM withdrawals, banking security tips, customer journey, or mobile banking promos; works as a close-detail transition or B-roll.

assets.title: Man Picks Wallet Train Platform
assets.detailedDescription: Vertical photorealistic image of a middle-aged commuter kneeling on a busy train platform to pick up a brown leather wallet from the ground. The man wears a light checked shirt and dark trousers, holding a black briefcase; his expression is focused and concerned. The platform shows tactile yellow guidance strips, a blurred train and other passengers in the background, and an overhead digital departure board. Natural daylight, candid moment, shallow depth of field with strong foreground focus on the wallet and the man's hand.
assets.useCase: Short-reel B-roll for scenes about lost-and-found, commuter stress, travel safety tips, banking/identity PSA, or a narrative beat showing someone retrieving a dropped wallet at a busy station.

assets.title: Man Using Atm Orange Kiosk
assets.detailedDescription: Photorealistic vertical shot of an adult man from behind using an outdoor ATM installed in a bright orange kiosk with a large circular 'i' info logo above. The subject wears a light blue dress shirt and navy trousers and stands on a small tiled platform while interacting with the ATM screen and card slot. The kiosk interior is metallic gray with an overhead recessed light and a small dome security camera. To the right is a glass storefront with a potted plant; the left background shows an urban sidewalk, parked cars and leafy trees. Natural daylight creates soft, even lighting and a routine, transactional mood.
assets.useCase: Short reel establishing or B-roll shot for banking, ATM usage, finance tutorials, security features, or urban lifestyle scenes showing a customer withdrawing cash.

assets.title: Man Withdrawing Cash Atm Outdoor
assets.detailedDescription: Side-profile mid-shot of a man in business-casual clothing (light blue button-up shirt, dark trousers) using a freestanding outdoor ATM. He is standing at a grey, metallic ATM kiosk with an angled screen and keypad, reaching into the cash dispenser where banknotes are visible. The scene is in daylight with soft natural lighting and shallow depth of field; a reflective glass storefront and blurred urban background are visible behind him. Framing focuses on the interaction between the user’s hands and the machine rather than the person's identity.
assets.useCase: Short reel mid-shot to illustrate ATM cash withdrawal, personal banking, transaction security, or a cutaway in a financial services ad or instructional video.

assets.title: Matte Black Rounded Screen Mockup
assets.detailedDescription: Centered, photorealistic 3D-render of a large matte-black rounded rectangle (screen-like surface) on a clean white background. The shape has soft, wide corner radii, a subtle top-left specular highlight and a gentle drop shadow that creates a floating effect; no text, icons or device bezel are present, leaving ample negative space for overlays or compositing.
assets.useCase: Use as a neutral screen placeholder or background in a short reel for app demos, title cards, product reveals, transitions, or to composite text and UI elements on top.

assets.title: Mobile Finance Dashboard Over Shoulder
assets.detailedDescription: Photorealistic vertical over-the-shoulder shot of a business-casual man holding a modern smartphone displaying a blue-themed mobile dashboard UI. The screen shows a large blue card, four square action icons, list items and a circular progress/pie chart. The subject interacts with the app using his right index finger; the left hand and wristwatch are visible. Background is a warm, softly blurred desk scene with a coffee cup, notebook and glass vase, lit by natural sunlight that creates soft highlights and shallow depth of field.
assets.useCase: Cutaway/close-up shot for a short reel demonstrating a mobile finance or analytics app — ideal for onboarding screens, feature highlights, fintech ads, or UX walkthrough transitions.

assets.title: Modern Bank Branch Customer Service Counter
assets.detailedDescription: Wide-angle photorealistic interior of a modern bank branch showing a long service counter with multiple teller stations separated by glass partitions. Several customers sit across from staff who are using computers; the space features wood-clad columns, potted plants, beige tile flooring and recessed ceiling lights. A customer in a colorful sari provides a strong color accent against an otherwise neutral, warm palette. The composition offers an unobstructed floor-to-ceiling perspective suitable for establishing or B-roll footage.
assets.useCase: Short reel establishing shot or B-roll for a bank/fintech promo, branch tour, customer service training, or trust-building CTA — works as a 3–6s pan or static cutaway.

assets.title: Modern Bank Branch Teller Counter Portrait
assets.detailedDescription: Vertical photorealistic shot of a modern bank branch interior showing multiple teller stations. Foreground shows a seated male customer speaking with a female teller across a glass partition; midground has additional tellers and seated customers at marble counters; background shows the lobby with people walking toward glass entry doors. Warm overhead pendant lighting, recessed ceiling lights, wood-paneled walls, framed artwork, and large windows providing natural backlight create a professional, busy banking atmosphere. Clean composition with shallow depth of field and clear visual layers (foreground interaction, midground service desks, background entrance).
