assets.title: Stacked Bimetal Coins Growth Chart
assets.detailedDescription: Portrait-oriented photorealistic image showing five stacks of bimetallic gold-and-silver coins arranged left-to-right on a wooden surface, each stack progressively taller to represent increasing value. Behind the stacks are five white rectangular bar silhouettes forming a bar chart, topped by a white zig-zag arrow pointing up and to the right. The background is a warm brown gradient with soft, even lighting and shallow depth of field; the foreground coins have visible rim lighting and crisp edge detail. Large negative space above the chart allows for text or overlays.
assets.useCase: Use as a vertical hero shot or background in short reel clips or social ads to illustrate rising profits, investment growth, savings milestones, or to serve as a backdrop for an end-screen CTA; ideal for animating coins rising or overlaying growth metrics.

assets.title: Stacked Checked List Icon
assets.detailedDescription: A flat UI icon showing two stacked checklist items: on the left are two rounded-square checkboxes with white check marks, and on the right are paired groups of three horizontal pill-shaped text placeholders representing list lines. The top checkbox uses a light cyan-to-sky-blue gradient, while the bottom checkbox shifts to a deeper blue-to-violet gradient. All elements have soft rounded corners, generous spacing between the two rows, and a transparent background suitable for overlaying on app screens or UI mockups.
assets.useCase: Use as a UI/UX overlay or cutaway in a short reel to represent completed tasks, a todo-list feature reveal, checklist confirmation, or app onboarding step; pairs well with a quick check animation and transition to a content screen.

assets.title: Stacked Coins Uptrend Arrow
assets.detailedDescription: Flat vector-style icon showing three ascending stacks of gold coins (left to right) topped with large round coins imprinted with dollar signs. A thick, rounded green zigzag arrow rises from the lower-left to the upper-right, visually intersecting or passing behind the stacks to indicate upward financial momentum. Colors are warm gold/yellow for coins and a medium green for the arrow; the shapes are rounded, filled, and outline-free, with a clean, minimal composition and a transparent or neutral background suitable for overlay use.
assets.useCase: Overlay or callout in short finance reels to illustrate revenue growth, profit increases, investment returns, or positive financial trends—suitable for dashboard highlights, end frames, or animated transitions.

assets.title: Stacked Columns Icon
assets.detailedDescription: A high-contrast flat icon: a white geometric glyph of three stacked vertical rectangular columns centered inside a black rounded-square tile. The composition has generous inner padding, crisp edges, no gradients, and a bold minimalist look designed for UI, dashboards, and technology-themed video overlays or lower thirds.
assets.useCase: Use as a tech or infrastructure UI/icon in short reels — e.g., app demos, dashboard transitions, lower-thirds, or animated overlays about servers/storage.

assets.title: Stacked Financial Reports Pen Calculator Desk
assets.detailedDescription: Close-up, vertical photograph of a wooden office desk covered with stacked printed financial reports and charts. A silver metal pen rests on top of the papers showing a visible pie chart and bar graph. A standard calculator sits in the lower-right foreground; a blurred pen holder, small potted plant, folders and a warm desk lamp are visible in the softly focused background. The image uses shallow depth of field and warm, directional lamp lighting to emphasize the documents and tools used for accounting or budgeting.
assets.useCase: Short reel B-roll or transition shot to introduce accounting, bookkeeping, budgeting, tax or financial analysis segments — works as an establishing close-up or overlay background for animated text or voiceover.

assets.title: Stacked Invoice 3d Icon
assets.detailedDescription: High-resolution 3D-render icon of a stacked invoice pad viewed at a slight diagonal tilt. The top sheet is labeled 'INVOICE' in a bold sans-serif heading and contains a minimal, grid-style invoice layout with placeholder lines and boxes for bill-to, description, quantity, price and total. The paper stack shows layered edges and realistic thickness. Lighting is soft with a subtle rim highlight and gentle drop shadow on a neutral gray gradient background, giving a clean, professional, print-ready appearance. Text on the form is intentionally minimal and low-contrast to preserve a generic template look.
assets.useCase: Short reel shot to represent billing, invoicing or payment steps — ideal for a transition or close-up in an explainer video, app onboarding flow, billing summary scene, or finance product promo where a document or receipt visual is needed.

assets.title: Stacked Invoice Paper 3d Render
assets.detailedDescription: Photorealistic 3D-render of a neatly stacked pile of invoice sheets viewed from a tilted top-down perspective. The top page shows a minimal invoice layout with a bold "INVOICE" header, form fields, and a grid for line items. Papers are bright white with subtle edge thickness visible on the stack. Lighting is soft and even, producing a faint vignette and a smooth gray gradient background with a soft shadow under the stack. Overall aesthetic is clean, neutral, and professional.
assets.useCase: Use as a cut or overlay in a short reel to illustrate invoicing, billing, payment, accounting workflows, or finance-related UI transitions; works well as a hero shot for billing segments or quick motion graphics.

assets.title: Stacked Polaroid Photo Icon
assets.detailedDescription: A clean icon of two overlapping Polaroid-style instant photos angled slightly against a soft grey vertical-gradient background. Each photo has a thick white border with a wider bottom edge and a solid dark (black-to-deep-grey) placeholder for the image area. The top frame is offset and rotated slightly clockwise over the bottom frame, with subtle drop shadows and a faint halo glow behind the stack for depth. The overall look is minimal, neutral-toned and designed as a UI asset or placeholder graphic.
assets.useCase: Use as a short-reel overlay or cutaway to represent photos, memories, galleries or image placeholders — ideal for transitions, intro/outro frames, thumbnail placeholders, or app UI mockups in a short video.

assets.title: Stacked Rupee Coins Calculator Calendar Desk
assets.detailedDescription: Vertical close-up photoreal shot of a desktop finance setup. Foreground shows multiple neat stacks and a few scattered bi-metallic Indian rupee coins on a matte beige surface next to a black calculator. Midground contains a leather notebook with eyeglasses, a stack of paperwork with a black-and-gold pen, and a spiral desk calendar with one date circled in red. Background is softly blurred with a vintage alarm clock and a small potted plant. Warm, directional lighting and shallow depth of field create soft bokeh, emphasizing the metallic sheen of the coins and the textured paper and leather.
assets.useCase: Use as a close-up B-roll or insert in a short reel to illustrate savings, budgeting, tax or invoice deadlines, personal finance tips, or small-business accounting; works as a transition shot or background for on-screen text.

assets.title: Stacked Rupee Gold Coins 3d Render
assets.detailedDescription: Photorealistic 3D-render of a vertical stack of shiny gold coins embossed with the Indian rupee (₹) symbol. Several coins are captured mid-air above the stack to suggest motion and falling currency. The coins have ridged edges, high-gloss metallic reflections and warm rim lighting. Background is a smooth warm gold gradient that fades into a deep black lower area with a subtle white vignette and faint corner frame marks, providing a natural space for overlays or captions. Composition is centered in the upper two-thirds of the frame, leaving prominent dark negative space below for text or UI elements.
assets.useCase: Use as an intro or transition shot in short finance reels, investment promos or app splash screens — top-centered visual with lower dark area reserved for captions, CTAs or UI overlays.

assets.title: Student Night Study Desk Notebook
assets.detailedDescription: Warm, cinematic over-the-shoulder portrait of a student writing in a spiral-bound notebook on a wooden desk at night. The scene is lit by a single desk lamp casting amber light across the page and the writer's hand, creating strong highlights and soft shadows. Visible elements include a pen held in the right hand, a stack of hardcover books to the right, a mesh pen holder with pencils, a coffee mug, and several pastel sticky notes on the desk. The composition emphasizes the notebook and hand in sharp focus with a shallow depth of field, while the writer's profile, glasses, and background fall into softer shadow. Vertical orientation suitable for mobile reels and story formats.
assets.useCase: Short reel or B-roll shot for study tips, productivity reels, online course promos, note-taking tutorials, late-night study montages, or app onboarding screens where a close-up of writing/action is needed for overlay text.

assets.title: Student Study Desk Laptop Pie Chart
assets.detailedDescription: Photorealistic vertical portrait of a student working at a wooden desk. The shot is taken over the student's shoulder, showing their right hand writing in a spiral notebook while an open laptop displays a circular (pie/donut) chart and dashboard UI. Scene includes stacked textbooks on both sides, an open reference book in the foreground, a black desk lamp casting warm light, a window with soft natural daylight, a pencil holder with pens, and colored sticky notes on the wall. The composition emphasizes focused study and data review in a cozy, organized workspace with neutral warm tones and shallow depth of field.
assets.useCase: Short-reel B-roll or cutaway for e-learning, study tips, remote learning, productivity apps, or student-focused promos — works as an opener, transition, or illustrative insert showing note-taking and data review.

assets.title: Studio Condenser Microphone Shockmount 3d Icon
assets.detailedDescription: Photorealistic vertical close-up of a large-diaphragm studio condenser microphone suspended in a shock mount. The image shows a tightly woven metal mesh grille, matte black cylindrical body, visible shock-mount frame and XLR connector with cable. Warm rim lighting from the upper right creates a subtle halo and highlights the textured grille and metal edges, while a dark, horizontally banded gradient background provides moody contrast and negative space for overlays. High-detail surface reflections and deep blacks emphasize a cinematic, premium audio equipment look.
assets.useCase: Hero close-up or overlay icon in short reels for podcasts, voiceover demos, streaming intros, audio equipment promos, or transition shots where a cinematic mic visual signals an audio-focused segment.

assets.title: Studio Podcast Editing Laptop
assets.detailedDescription: Vertical photorealistic shot of a home audio studio desk: a laptop displaying a dark-themed digital audio workstation with a bright blue waveform and MIDI/timeline blocks on screen, a large condenser microphone suspended on the right, closed-back headphones resting on the desk, a notebook and pen in the foreground, and a coffee mug and warm filament lamp in the background. The scene is lit with moody blue key lighting and a warm accent light, shallow depth of field, cinematic contrast, and a 9:16 portrait crop ideal for mobile reels.
assets.useCase: Insert/establishing shot in short-form reels for podcast production, audio-editing tutorials, voiceover workflows, or creator studio B-roll — works as a vertical background for text overlays and lower-thirds.

assets.title: Subtle Futuristic Hud Overlay
assets.detailedDescription: Portrait-oriented dark gray texture designed as a subtle futuristic HUD overlay. The image features multiple ultra-thin horizontal scanlines and faint banding across a cool steel-gray gradient, punctuated by small star-like glints and soft lens-flare points. A faint concentric circular ring sits on the left-middle area and a rounded rectangular frame appears near the lower third; both are low‑opacity and finely outlined. Overall the asset has a low-contrast, smoky vignette and delicate film grain that give a moody, high-tech ambience without overpowering foreground elements.
assets.useCase: Use as a subtle sci‑fi HUD overlay or moody background in a short reel shot — ideal for transitions, title cards, UI reveals, or as a lower-third backdrop behind text and icons.

assets.title: Sunlit Blank Letter Magnifier Pen On Wood Desk
assets.detailedDescription: Vertical overhead portrait of a single blank white sheet of textured paper placed on a warm wood desk. Soft, diagonal sunlight filters across the scene, casting distinct leaf-shaped shadows from a potted plant at the top-left. A black and gold fountain pen rests along the left edge of the paper; a brass-rim magnifying glass with a wooden handle sits partly on the lower-right corner, reflecting a windowpane. A neat stack of clipped papers is visible in the top-right background. The composition emphasizes negative space on the paper for text or mockups and conveys a calm, editorial home-office mood.
assets.useCase: Opening or transition shot in a short reel for stationery mockups, letterhead or invitation previews, writing/creative workflow scenes, or as a textured background for overlaid text and titles.

assets.title: Sunlit Cozy Desk Corkboard Moodboard
assets.detailedDescription: Vertical photorealistic still of a warm, sunlit workspace: a framed corkboard leans against a textured wall and displays assorted pinned items (blank sheets, small photos, pastel sticky notes) arranged as a moodboard. In the foreground on a wooden desk are a spiral notebook with a gold pen, stacked pastel sticky note pads, a closed kraft notebook, a ceramic coffee mug, and a small lit candle. A potted plant sits to the left casting soft foliage shadows on the wall. Soft directional late-afternoon light creates warm highlights and long, soft shadows; color palette is neutral earth tones with muted pastels, creating a calm, cozy, organized mood.
assets.useCase: Opening or transition shot for productivity, planning, or lifestyle reels; background for text overlays or product/stationery mockups; establishes calm, organized mood in short-form videos.

assets.title: Sunlit Cozy Desk Open Notebook Tea
assets.detailedDescription: Vertical photorealistic shot of a warm, sunlit workspace: an open blank notebook with a gold pen rests in the foreground on a light oak desk. To the left is a speckled ceramic cup of tea on a wooden coaster and a potted green houseplant in a textured neutral planter. On the right, stacked neutral-toned books, a smooth pebble paperweight and a small cup of pens sit beneath a soft-glowing desk lamp. Soft natural light from a window casts warm, elongated shadows and gentle highlights across wood grain, ceramic, paper and plant leaves, creating a calm, minimalist composition ideal for lifestyle or productivity scenes.
assets.useCase: B-roll or hero cutaway for morning routine, journaling, study or remote-work reels; works as a calm transition shot or background for on-screen text and product overlays.

assets.title: Sunlit Cozy Home Desk Laptop Mug Plant
assets.detailedDescription: Warm, photorealistic interior still showing a sunlit wooden desk in a cozy living-room workspace. Foreground: a closed silver laptop, a speckled ceramic coffee mug on a wooden coaster, and a textured stone planter with glossy green leaves. Midground/background: soft-focus sofa, round coffee table, large potted tree by a bright window and a wooden sideboard with books and a lamp. Golden morning light streams through the window casting soft shadows and dappled highlights; overall neutral beige and warm wood palette with green accents from plants. Low-angle eye-level composition with a shallow depth of field and pronounced bokeh.
assets.useCase: Short reel establishing shot or b-roll for work-from-home, remote productivity, morning routine, or interior design content — slow pan or rack focus from mug/plant to laptop then out to the room.

assets.title: Sunlit Curved Stone Staircase
assets.detailedDescription: Vertical photorealistic image of a wide, ascending curved stone staircase framed by smooth stucco walls. Warm golden sunlight floods the scene from above, creating long, soft shadows across the steps and a gentle gradient from deep amber at the bottom to pale cream near the top. A small cluster of leafy branches casts dappled shadows on the right wall. The composition is minimal and uncluttered, no people or objects present, emphasizing architectural lines, texture, and an aspirational upward perspective.
assets.useCase: Use as an establishing or transition shot in short reels to suggest ascent, progress or transformation; ideal for title overlays, slow upward dolly, or meditative pause between scenes.

assets.title: Sunlit Entryway Beige Sneakers
assets.detailedDescription: Photorealistic vertical shot of a warm, sunlit entryway. A pair of beige knit sneakers sit on a honey-toned wooden floor at the left foreground next to a textured woven doormat. Soft morning/golden-hour sunlight streams through an open wooden door on the right, casting long, dappled shadows across the floor and wall. A tall potted green houseplant is partially visible on the left beside a white baseboard. Through the open door a blurred stone path and lush green garden are visible, creating depth and a relaxed indoor-outdoor transition.
assets.useCase: Establishing or B-roll shot in a short reel to introduce a morning routine, showcase footwear in a lifestyle ecommerce edit, or provide a calm transition from interior to garden scenes.

assets.title: Sunlit Glass And Phone On Wooden Desk
assets.detailedDescription: Vertical photorealistic photo of a sunlit wooden desk by a window. Foreground shows a ribbed glass of water casting bright caustic reflections across the wood grain. To the right sits a black-cased smartphone with a blank screen angled slightly toward the camera. Behind the phone is a potted pothos (green heart-shaped leaves) in a neutral ceramic pot and soft beige curtains diffusing daylight. Warm golden-hour tones, shallow depth of field, and natural soft shadows create a cozy, minimal home-office or morning-routine atmosphere.
assets.useCase: Ideal as a short-reel b-roll or transition shot for morning routine, hydration reminders, app/product mockups (phone screen overlay), home office scenes, or cozy lifestyle branding; works well for slow pans or screen-replacement inserts.

assets.title: Sunlit Jar Of Rupee Coins
assets.detailedDescription: Photorealistic vertical portrait of a clear glass jar filled with two-tone metal coins (silver centers, gold rims) sitting on a light tabletop. Warm diagonal sunlight casts soft window-shaped shadows across a neutral textured wall; a potted plant and framed art sit out of focus in the background creating a cozy indoor scene. Several coins are scattered in the foreground; the jar shows realistic glass reflections, crisp coin edges, and a shallow depth of field that keeps focus on the pile of coins.
assets.useCase: Hero close-up in a short reel about saving money or budgeting — use as an opening or cutaway shot to illustrate savings, goals, or investment themes with room for text overlay in the upper-left negative space.

assets.title: Sunlit Kitchen Water Bottle Fruit Still Life
assets.detailedDescription: Portrait-oriented photoreal still-life of a tall clear glass water bottle with a stainless-steel lid and fabric strap standing on a light beige kitchen countertop. Foreground elements include a ceramic bowl of strawberries, a whole lemon, a halved orange on a wooden cutting board with bananas, and a spiral notebook with a pen. Soft warm morning sunlight streams from a window, creating gentle highlights and long soft shadows; a potted herb and wooden cutting boards sit blurred in the background, producing a shallow depth of field and a calm, healthy lifestyle mood.
assets.useCase: Use as an establishing or insert shot in a short reel for morning routine, wellness or hydration tips, reusable bottle product promos, recipe planning sequences, or social media lifestyle content.

assets.title: Sunlit Zen Meditation Corner Pouf
assets.detailedDescription: Vertical photorealistic interior shot of a sunlit meditation corner. A round beige meditation cushion (zafu/pouf) sits centered on a textured jute rug on warm wooden floors. Soft sheer curtains filter golden-hour light from the left, casting patterned window shadows on the wall and floor. A low wooden bench at the left holds a small potted fern and a lit pillar candle; a wooden tray in the foreground contains an incense stick holder and a raw crystal. A large potted ficus/tree in a ceramic planter anchors the right side of the frame. Neutral earthy tones, tactile natural materials (linen, jute, wood, ceramic), and shallow depth of field create a calm, cozy, minimalist, hygge/zen mood suitable for wellness or lifestyle content.
assets.useCase: Vertical establishing or hero shot for a short wellness/mindfulness reel—use as an opening scene, background for quote overlays, or product lifestyle staging for cushions, decor, or meditation classes.

assets.title: Tablet Analytics Dashboard Dark Desk
assets.detailedDescription: A photorealistic top-down angled shot of a tablet resting on a dark textured desk displaying a dark-mode analytics dashboard with multiple charts (donut, line, bar, and sparkline) in blue and purple gradients. Scene includes a black coffee cup, small potted plant (top-left), and a closed notebook with a silver pen (bottom-right), soft directional lighting, subtle reflections on the tablet bezel, and shallow depth of field for a moody, professional workspace look.
assets.useCase: Hero or cutaway shot in a short reel to showcase a finance or analytics app UI, product demo, or promotional B-roll for a tech presentation.

assets.title: Tablet Growth Chart Desk
assets.detailedDescription: Photorealistic vertical shot of a modern tablet propped on a wooden desk displaying a dark UI with bright blue bar and line charts showing upward growth. Foreground includes an open spiral notebook with a black pen resting on it, black-rimmed eyeglasses to the left, and a black coffee mug to the right. A small potted plant sits near the tablet; a bookshelf and a sunlit window with greenery are softly focused in the background. Warm natural light casts soft shadows across the wood grain, creating a focused, productive office atmosphere with shallow depth of field and soft bokeh behind the main objects.
assets.useCase: B-roll or establishing close-up in a short reel for finance/business content — use as a transition or overlay when discussing growth metrics, earnings, productivity tips, or investment performance.

assets.title: Taped Mint Badge Speech Bubble
assets.detailedDescription: A dark, rounded rectangular speech bubble icon with a small pointed tail at the lower-left and a mint-green circular 'tape' badge overlapping the top-right corner. The bubble has a semi-translucent charcoal interior, thin black outline, subtle inner bevel and soft drop shadow that create a floating 3D appearance. The mint badge is rimmed with a thin darker ring and casts its own shadow, suggesting a taped-on or pinned look. Background shows a muted vertical brushed gradient that emphasizes the icon's depth.
assets.useCase: Use as a UI callout or pinned chat notification in a short reel: slide in as a message overlay, lower-third text container, or pinned sticky note to highlight a quick tip or alert during a product demo or tutorial.

assets.title: Taped Paper Note Square
assets.detailedDescription: Photorealistic square white paper note, taped at the top center with a single piece of beige masking tape. The paper is slightly rotated clockwise, has a clean, unmarked surface for overlays, and casts a soft drop shadow and subtle halo glow onto a vertical gray gradient background with faint banding. The tape shows a torn edge texture and a warm yellowish highlight behind it, giving the composition a pinned/memo look suitable for on-screen callouts.
assets.useCase: Use as a close-up overlay or callout in a short reel: hold on screen while text, checklist items, or step numbers animate in; works as a title card, pinned note, or storyboard annotation.

assets.title: Task List Checked Gradient Icon
assets.detailedDescription: Flat 2D icon showing a vertical three-item checklist: on the left of each row is a solid circular badge with a cutout checkmark, and on the right are rounded pill-shaped text blocks with two horizontal stroke indicators. The shapes use a smooth cyan-to-violet horizontal gradient, high contrast cutouts for the checkmarks and lines, and a transparent background optimized for UI and video overlays.
assets.useCase: Use as a UI overlay or motion asset to represent completed tasks or checklist progress in app demos, product reels, onboarding sequences, or dashboard animations.

assets.title: Team Brainstorm Postit Workshop Vertical
assets.detailedDescription: Portrait-oriented, photorealistic image of a small team collaboratively working around a table covered in a dense grid of multicolored sticky notes. Four people lean over the table, writing and pointing at notes while two open laptops display charts and graphs. A whiteboard with additional sticky notes and printed charts fills the background; a potted plant and large window add natural elements. Warm overhead lighting creates a focused, intimate mood and strong highlights on the notes and hands. The scene reads as an active design/strategy workshop or sprint-planning session in a modern office with concrete walls.
assets.useCase: B-roll or primary cut in a short reel showing team brainstorming, sprint planning, UX workshops, or agency collaboration scenes—ideal for intros, transitions, or social mobile formats.

assets.title: Team Collaboration Avatar Badge
assets.detailedDescription: Flat, circular PNG icon showing three friendly, overlapping avatars arranged in a front-to-back composition: a central male figure in a navy suit and blue tie, a female figure with reddish hair and a blue top to the left-rear, and a dark-haired male in a white shirt with a red tie to the right-rear. The group sits on a warm yellow circular background; faces are simple with rounded features, minimal facial details, and no outlines, creating a clean, friendly corporate look suited for UI and presentation use.
assets.useCase: Use as a UI or presentation icon for team, collaboration, about-us, or onboarding shots; works as a reel intro/outro badge, section marker, or overlay in product demos and corporate explainer clips.

assets.title: Tech Notification Neon Glass Flow
assets.detailedDescription: A futuristic, glassy notification UI card rendered in 3D with neon blue and orange highlights. The horizontal rounded card features a glowing play button on the left, an envelope/message icon in the center, and three lines representing text on the right with a bright red circular '1' notification badge at the top-right. Two smaller rounded node cards sit below (left: gear/settings icon, right: checklist/document icon) and are connected to the main card by luminous, circuit-like lines with tiny spark particles. The composition sits on a dark vertical-gradient background with soft vignetting and reflective gloss, giving a holographic, high-tech mood.
assets.useCase: Close-up overlay or lower-third shot in a short reel to illustrate notifications, message alerts, workflow connections, or a UI demo during product promos or onboarding sequences.

assets.title: Thin Outline Rounded Label Bar
assets.detailedDescription: A horizontal, elongated rounded-rectangle label icon with a thin double black outline and an off-white interior. The shape has soft 8px-radius corners, a subtle inner bevel and a faint drop shadow that gives a slight raised effect. The label sits centered on a muted vertical metallic gray gradient background, creating contrast between the bright label and the cool backdrop. Clean, minimal, high-contrast stroke styling suitable as a UI element or overlay.
assets.useCase: Used as a UI label or button placeholder in a short reel — appears as a lower-third text bar, search/form field mock, or callout overlay during an app or product demo shot.

assets.title: Three Checked Tasks List
assets.detailedDescription: Flat, vector-style icon depicting a vertical three-item checklist. Each row pairs a circular badge on the left containing a solid checkmark with a rounded rectangular "pill" on the right containing two short horizontal lines that represent text. The badges and pills share a smooth cyan-to-violet gradient, with solid dark marks for the check and text strokes, on a transparent background. Even spacing and consistent proportions make this asset suitable for UI lists, onboarding screens, and motion transitions.
assets.useCase: Used as a UI overlay or cutaway in a short reel to indicate completed tasks, checklist progress, or to represent a task list block during app onboarding or feature highlights.

assets.title: Three Row Checklist Line
assets.detailedDescription: Minimal outline icon showing a stacked checklist composed of three wide, rounded rectangles aligned vertically with equal spacing. Each row contains a left‑aligned circular marker (empty circle) and a long rounded label area to the right. The graphic uses thin black outlines with white fills for the shapes and a subtle inner shadow; the canvas shows a vertical brushed‑metal gradient background (grey to dark grey) that provides contrast but the icon itself is line‑based and monocolor. Clean geometry, consistent corner radii, and even padding make this suitable for UI overlays and app mockups.
assets.useCase: Use as a UI overlay or lower-third element in short product reels to represent multi-item task lists, menus, or checklist steps during app demos and onboarding transitions.

assets.title: Torn Paper Frame Overlay
assets.detailedDescription: High-contrast torn paper frame icon: a square white paper border with irregular, ragged edges and visible paper grain, rendered as a PNG with transparent center and background. Subtle inner shadow and edge texture give the flat silhouette a tactile, slightly distressed look suitable for layering over photos or video. Clean alpha channel preserves the irregular outline for seamless compositing at different scales.
assets.useCase: Use as an overlay/frame in short-form reels and story shots to highlight photos, title cards, product close-ups, or scrapbook/transitional scenes.

assets.title: Transfer Arrows Line Icon
assets.detailedDescription: A minimal line-style transfer icon intended for UI and video overlays. The design centers on a bidirectional/transfer motif (two opposing arrows or looped arrows) rendered as a clean, thin white stroke on a dark or transparent background. The preview image includes a tiled 'icon' watermark across the canvas — asset is clearly legible at small sizes and optimized for consistent stroke weight and balanced negative space, making it suitable for on-screen buttons, lower-thirds, and transition overlays.
assets.useCase: Ideal as a short-reel overlay or cutaway icon for transfer-related scenes: transaction flows, send/receive actions, account-to-account transfers, exchange UX walkthroughs, or confirmation animations.

assets.title: Translucent Mobile Analytics Cards
assets.detailedDescription: Three translucent, frosted-glass smartphone mockups angled in a shallow fan, centered on a cool blue-gray gradient background. The middle phone is prominent and displays a rising line chart above a smaller bar/line widget; the left phone shows an image placeholder and text blocks; the right phone shows a multicolored donut chart and a small bar chart. Soft blue glow, subtle drop shadows and a slight depth-of-field give a polished, modern UI-mockup look. Overall mood is calm, professional and futuristic, optimized for use as a tech/product visual.
assets.useCase: Short-reel intro or transition shot to showcase mobile analytics, product features, dashboard previews, or as a B-roll overlay behind captions in app promo videos.

assets.title: Two Person Meeting Laptop Icon
assets.detailedDescription: Flat-style icon showing two business professionals seated at a small round table. Both figures wear dark suits; one has a visible tie and a laptop open on the table between them. Teal molded chairs and a coral-red round table create a distinctive color contrast. Faces are simplified with flat color blocks (no detailed facial features). The composition is slightly angled, showing full seated poses and visible legs and shoes.
assets.useCase: Quick overlay or cut-in for business reels: one-on-one meetings, client pitches, interviews, HR reviews, onboarding or sales sequences (2–5 second shot to illustrate collaboration).

assets.title: Upward Growth Bars Arrow
assets.detailedDescription: Flat, multicolor growth icon showing four rounded vertical bars in ascending height (left to right) — yellow, orange, green, and blue — sitting on a dark horizontal baseline. A thick, curved red arrow rises from the lower-left, sweeping above the bars and pointing up-right to indicate positive trend or growth. The artwork uses simple two-tone fills and subtle inner highlights, with a transparent background and clean, geometric forms suitable for UI and motion graphics.
assets.useCase: Used as a cutaway or overlay in short reel shots to represent growth, rising KPIs, revenue increase, or successful outcomes — ideal for dashboard transitions, explainer clips, or end-frame callouts.

assets.title: Verified Gold Medal Rosette
assets.detailedDescription: A high-gloss 3D rendered verified badge: a teal-green circular center with a raised checkmark, surrounded by a polished gold rim and a layered blue rosette with scalloped edges. Bright specular highlights, small glowing particles and a golden sparkle accent the upper right; soft vignette and drop shadow lift the medal off a dark gradient background. The badge shows pronounced beveling, metallic reflections and a premium, celebratory finish.
assets.useCase: Use as a pop-up or end-frame badge in short reels for profile verification, achievement unlocks, success confirmations or trust seals; ideal for animated reveals with sparkles and light sweep.

assets.title: Vertical Podcast Streaming Desk Setup
assets.detailedDescription: Vertical photorealistic studio desk scene for streaming and podcasting: a smartphone mounted on a small tripod in front of a large illuminated ring light, a condenser microphone on a desktop stand, an open laptop, coffee mug and a dark textured desk. Background includes warm shelf lighting with plants and bulbs and a cool blue vertical LED, creating a cinematic warm-and-cool contrast and shallow depth-of-field. Vertical composition and negative space make this asset ideal for mobile-first reels, livestream thumbnails, and short social clips.
assets.useCase: B-roll or establishing shot for a short-form reel showing a creator's streaming/podcast setup — works as an intro/outro, thumbnail backdrop, or overlay-ready clip with room for lower-third text.

assets.title: Vertical Waveform Pink Orange
assets.detailedDescription: A flat, minimal icon showing five vertical rounded bars that form a stylized audio waveform. Bars vary in height with the tallest second from the left and slightly staggered spacing. The fill uses a smooth left-to-right gradient from hot pink/magenta through coral to bright orange. Rounded capsule ends, no outlines, and a transparent background make the icon scalable and suitable for overlays or UI use. High contrast and saturated colors give it an energetic, modern look.
assets.useCase: Use as an overlay or UI icon to indicate audio, music, podcast, or voice recording in short reels — ideal for player controls, animated transitions, lower-thirds, and intro/outro stingers.

assets.title: Video Document Badge
assets.detailedDescription: Square UI icon (512x512) depicting a light-gray document with rounded corners and a folded top-right corner. The document is outlined in dark blue and overlaid by a horizontal, rounded-corner blue badge that reads "VIDEO" in bold white all-caps. The badge features a left-to-right deep-blue gradient and a subtle drop shadow that separates it from the paper background. Clean, high-contrast composition optimized for toolbars, file lists, and media libraries.
assets.style: flat-icon with subtle gradient and drop shadow
assets.useCase: Use as an overlay or thumbnail in a short reel to mark items as video content — e.g., in media libraries, file lists, onboarding screens, or quick transitions indicating a downloadable/playable video clip.

assets.title: Video Editing Scissors Gradient Icon
assets.detailedDescription: A modern flat icon representing video editing: a rectangular filmstrip or player window with perforated top and bottom edges, a centered play triangle, and a pair of scissors overlaid on the lower-right corner indicating cut/trim. The artwork uses a smooth cyan-to-purple gradient stroke and solid play triangle, rounded corners and consistent line weight. Designed for a transparent background and scalable as a vector-style asset for UI and motion graphics.
assets.useCase: Use as an overlay or toolbar/icon in short reels to indicate trimming/cutting actions — ideal for video editor UI, tutorial callouts, app buttons, and social-media editing prompts.

assets.title: Vintage Alarm Clock Blank Calendar Sunlit
assets.detailedDescription: A vertical photorealistic still-life of a black vintage twin-bell alarm clock next to a spiral-bound blank desk calendar, placed on a dark wooden desk with stacked notebooks and a pen. Warm golden sunlight streams in from the upper left, casting dramatic, soft-edged shadows and highlights across the clock face, calendar grid, and tabletop. The scene uses low-key contrast and shallow depth of field to emphasize the clock and calendar as focal points while keeping the background softly textured and unobtrusive.
assets.useCase: Serves as an establishing or transition shot in short reels about productivity, time management, scheduling, goal-setting, or morning routines; works as a moody background for title cards, text overlays, or countdowns.

assets.title: Vintage Tape Photo Corners
assets.detailedDescription: A set of four photorealistic paper tape photo corners arranged in each quadrant to form a frame. Each corner shows a warm, yellowed paper texture with torn, irregular edges and a visible adhesive strip across the top of the corner piece. Soft drop shadows and a subtle central vignette create depth and separation from the background. The overall look is nostalgic and handmade, suitable as an overlay or decorative frame element for photos, thumbnails, or short video reels.
assets.useCase: Used as a framing overlay in a short reel shot to create a vintage scrapbook look for photos or thumbnails — place over the clip to simulate taped photo corners during transitions or close-ups.

assets.title: Voice Wave Neumorphic
assets.detailedDescription: Rounded-square app-style icon featuring a left-to-right cyan-to-violet gradient background with five vertically rounded soundwave bars inset into the tile. The bars are centered, symmetrical (tallest in middle), and use subtle inner shadow and soft highlights to create a pressed/neumorphic effect. No text or microphone silhouette — minimal, modern, and optimized for UI use at small sizes.
assets.useCase: Serves as a UI asset for a short reel shot: appear as a voice/assistant button, audio status indicator, or onboarding cue in app demos and interface animations.

assets.title: Voice Waveform Gradient Square
assets.detailedDescription: A minimal flat icon showing a centered black audio waveform (five vertical rounded bars with the center bar tallest) on a rounded-square tile. The background is a smooth diagonal gradient shifting from bright cyan/blue at the top-left to vivid magenta/purple at the bottom-right. The waveform is a high-contrast silhouette, evenly spaced and symmetrical, creating a bold, modern look suitable for UI and app use.
assets.useCase: Use as a UI element or overlay in a short product reel to signal voice chat, recording, podcast segments, or a 'start recording' CTA — works as a feature highlight or animated button in app demos and social audio promos.

assets.title: Warm Beige Books Background Portrait
assets.detailedDescription: Vertical photorealistic background showing a warm beige paper-textured scene with soft directional light. Blurred stacks of books sit on the left and right edges, with an open book fanned at the bottom right and left. Decorative paper-curve borders at the top and bottom incorporate subtle gold flecks and circular line accents. The center is intentionally empty, offering a wide clean copy space with a shallow depth-of-field and gentle bokeh highlights. Overall mood is cozy, nostalgic and elegant, suitable for overlays and title cards.
assets.useCase: Use as a vertical reel or story background for book-related promos, reading challenge announcements, author reveals, education course intros, or as a title/overlay card where text and product shots are placed in the central negative space.

assets.title: Warm Vertical Cork Bulletin Board Desk Shot
assets.detailedDescription: Photorealistic vertical portrait scene of an empty cork bulletin board in a thin wooden frame, wall-mounted and lit from a single overhead spotlight that creates a soft, top-centered vignette. The lower foreground shows a wooden desk with a neat stack of papers on the left, loose sheets in front, and a small stack of books with a potted plant on the right. Warm brown tones, subtle texture on the cork surface, and soft shadows produce a cinematic, moody atmosphere ideal for overlays, mockups, or announcement copy.
assets.useCase: Use as a portrait-oriented reel or story background for title cards, announcements, product mockups or overlay text; works as an establishing shot, reveal backdrop, or pause-frame for short videos.

assets.title: Wavy Ring Corner Peel Red
assets.detailedDescription: 3D-render icon showing a centered scalloped (wavy) triple-line circular ring in dark charcoal/black on a subtle vertical-gradient gray background with vignette. The top-right segment features a glossy, folded-triangle corner peel in bright red with a thin golden crease and soft red neon glow; soft shadows and slight blur create depth and a tactile, layered look.
assets.useCase: Overlay or header icon in a short reel: used as a table header strip indicator, notification/pinned-column badge, or animated peel reveal to highlight a new or important UI element in dashboard or product footage.

assets.title: Web Code Monitor Globe
assets.detailedDescription: Flat vector icon of a desktop monitor showing a browser window with centered code brackets (< />) and an overlapping globe at the lower-right. The artwork uses a cyan-to-violet gradient fill with bold black outline strokes, simplified geometric shapes and a rounded monitor stand for strong legibility at small sizes. Intended to represent web development, online code, APIs and web apps in UI, motion graphics, and video overlays.
assets.useCase: Mid-frame overlay or sticker in a short reel for web development tutorials, app feature highlights, API product intros, or tutorial title cards.

assets.title: Web Design Code Icon
assets.detailedDescription: Flat monochrome icon showing a dark rounded-square tile with a centered white circular inset that contains bold black angle brackets (</>) representing code. The design is minimal and geometric with thick, even stroke weight and generous negative space around the symbol. High-contrast, vector-style construction makes it legible at small sizes and suitable for overlays, UI elements, and motion graphics. Presumed transparent background for easy compositing.
assets.useCase: Use as a centered overlay or toolbar/button in short tech reels to introduce web development topics, coding tutorials, UI walkthroughs or app feature intros; ideal for scale/rotate animations into lower-thirds or scene transitions.

assets.title: Whatsapp Chat Bubble Icon
assets.detailedDescription: Flat green chat-bubble icon with a small tail at lower-left and a centered white telephone handset silhouette. Solid, high-contrast colors with crisp edges and a transparent background suitable for UI overlays, social links, or motion graphics.
assets.useCase: Use as a messaging/contact CTA or social link overlay in a short reel shot — ideal for lower-third or end-screen prompts to start a WhatsApp chat or call, or as a UI element in app demos and onboarding.

assets.title: White 3d Calculator Icon
assets.detailedDescription: A centered top-down 3D-render icon of a compact calculator: matte white body with a thin chrome-beveled frame, a glossy black rectangular display at the top, and five rows of rounded square white keys arranged in a numeric-like grid. The largest key (enter/space) is elongated on the right column. Keys are blank (no numbers or symbols) with subtle inner bevels and soft drop shadows. The composition sits on a vertical, softly striped gray vignette background with gentle reflections beneath the device, creating a minimalist, professional look suitable for UI and motion use.
assets.useCase: Close-up reveal or center-frame icon in a short reel to introduce finance, budgeting, calculator features or UI controls; works as a rotating or scaling element in transitions and lower-thirds.

assets.title: White Card Image Frame Icon
assets.detailedDescription: A minimal white card image frame icon on a transparent background: a rounded-rectangle card with a thin light-gray outline and an inner inset representing an image placeholder. The frame casts a soft, neutral-gray drop shadow that gives subtle depth while remaining flat and UI-friendly. Even padding and balanced corner radius make it suitable as a scalable PNG asset for interfaces, mockups, and motion reels where a clean image card placeholder is needed.
assets.useCase: Use as an image placeholder or card frame in short reel shots showcasing app UI — grid/gallery reveals, product carousel transitions, onboarding overlays, content-loading states, or mockup presentations.

assets.title: White Curled Lined Page
assets.detailedDescription: A single, high-contrast white sheet of paper rendered as an icon on a soft gray vignette background. The page is slightly tilted in perspective with faint horizontal ruling lines near the top, a subtle bevel along the edges, and a curled bottom-right corner that reveals a thin inner layer. Soft directional lighting creates a delicate highlight across the surface and a gentle drop shadow that lifts the paper off the background. Overall look is clean, minimal, and slightly three-dimensional.
assets.useCase: Use as a UI/document icon or transitional element in a short reel to represent a new note, blank document, editable form, or content placeholder; works well for title cards, app overlays, tutorial steps, and scene transitions.

assets.title: White Glow Photo Frame Border
assets.detailedDescription: A rectangular, landscape-oriented photo frame border with a bright white LED-like stroke and soft outer halo. The frame is medium-thick with a subtle inner bevel and an empty translucent center showing a cool gray gradient backdrop with faint vertical banding. Soft drop shadows and a subtle floor reflection anchor the frame against the textured metallic-gray background, creating a modern, minimal spotlight effect suitable as an overlay or mockup border.
assets.useCase: Use as a glowing photo-border overlay in short reel shots to spotlight user photos, product images, profile portraits, or thumbnails — place media inside the transparent center during transition, reveal, or highlight segments.

assets.title: White Metal Calculator Keypad Icon
assets.detailedDescription: Top-down centered icon of a minimalist calculator keypad rendered in a white/silver metallic material. The asset shows a rectangular device with rounded corners, a glossy black display window at the top, a tight grid of rounded-square blank keys, a tall vertical enter-style key on the right and a long horizontal bottom key. High-key lighting, subtle bevels and embossed shadows give pronounced depth; the background is a soft vertical gray gradient with a vignette.
assets.useCase: Close-up cut or overlay in a short reel to represent calculation, budgeting, numeric input or finance-related UI transitions and app intros.

assets.title: White Rounded Badge Red Corner
assets.detailedDescription: A clean, 3D-rendered white badge with rounded top corners and a single pointed bottom center, framed by a thin double black-and-white outline. The badge features a small red folded-corner triangle on the top-right that appears beveled, and casts a soft drop shadow and subtle glow onto a vertical brushed-steel grey background. The center is blank and lightly textured, optimized for overlaying short text or icons.
assets.useCase: Overlay badge or label in a short promo reel or UI mockup to indicate new/important status, sale, or callout; placed at the corner of product shots, onboarding screens, or title cards.

assets.title: White Skincare Packaging Stone Pedestals Pink Backdrop
assets.detailedDescription: Photorealistic vertical still of unbranded white skincare containers (squeeze tube, pump bottle, dropper bottle, jar, and small airless/stick bottle) arranged on rough-cut limestone pedestals. Soft warm directional sunlight casts long, diffused shadows and leaf silhouettes over a blush-pink fabric backdrop. Delicate white and pale-pink flowers frame the composition left and right, creating a soft, luxury spa mood ideal for label mockups or product hero shots.
assets.useCase: Intro or hero frame in a short skincare/reel: slow pan or slight parallax to reveal blank packaging for label mockups, product launch, or luxury beauty ads.

assets.title: Woman Silhouette Office Sunset View
assets.detailedDescription: Photorealistic vertical portrait of a young professional woman standing at a floor-to-ceiling office window, looking out over a dense city skyline during golden-hour sunset. She is shown in side profile with hair in a loose bun, wearing business-casual blouse and trousers, hands in pockets. Warm, directional sunset light creates rim lighting around her silhouette and casts golden reflections across the glass and distant buildings. The background cityscape is softly defocused with glowing bokeh highlights down a vanishing avenue, giving a cinematic, contemplative atmosphere suitable for corporate, lifestyle, or editorial uses.
assets.useCase: Use as a B-roll or establishing shot in a short reel—opening or transition for corporate storytelling, leadership messaging, recruitment ads, or contemplative lifestyle scenes.

assets.title: Work Plan Checklist Target Icon
assets.detailedDescription: Flat, colorful icon of a work plan document titled "Plan" with two green circular checkmarks, a stacked page effect, a blue speech/comment bubble, an orange briefcase at the bottom-left and a red-and-white target with an arrow hitting the bullseye at the bottom-right. The document has a bold blue header, light blue paper body with horizontal guideline strokes, rounded corners and subtle drop shadows to create layered depth. Designed as a vector-style UI asset for business and productivity contexts.
assets.useCase: Overlay or cutaway in a short reel to represent project planning, goal setting or task completion — works as a UI icon, intro card, or transition element in product demos and onboarding clips.

assets.title: Working Gear Orange Icon
assets.detailedDescription: Square rounded-corner icon on a white canvas featuring a central circular orange-to-red gradient button with a bold white gear (cog) silhouette. The gear has a clear central hole and evenly spaced teeth; the orange circle contains a subtle highlight at the upper-left and a soft shadow at the lower-right for slight depth. Generous padding around the circle keeps the composition clean and readable at small UI sizes. Overall appearance is a minimal, high-contrast flat-vector style optimized for app UI, thumbnails, and motion overlays.
assets.useCase: Use as a UI badge or overlay in short reels to indicate settings, processing/working state, maintenance, or configuration steps — ideal for animated spin-in, lower-third callouts, app walkthroughs, or transition graphics.

assets.title: Yellow Envelope Receive Download
assets.detailedDescription: Flat-style gradient icon showing an open yellow-to-orange envelope holding a white letter; a vivid green circular badge with a white downward arrow sits centered on the letter to indicate download/receive. The asset uses rounded corners, soft highlights and subtle shadows for depth, high contrast between the green badge and warm envelope, and a square canvas suitable for UI and motion graphics.
assets.useCase: Pop-in or slide-in mid-frame in a short reel to signal an incoming message or downloadable attachment — ideal for app walkthroughs, notifications, CTAs, and tutorial overlays.

assets.title: Yellow Highlighter Glow Stroke
assets.detailedDescription: A horizontal, hand-painted yellow highlighter stroke with a soft luminous glow. The mark reads as three slightly overlapping paint swipes with subtle inner streaks and edge fraying, producing a wet-marker texture. The stroke sits centered on a neutral gray gradient background, creating strong contrast and a floating effect. Bright neon-yellow core fades outward into a diffuse halo, and the overall aspect ratio is long and narrow to suit overlays or callouts.
assets.useCase: Use as a top-layer highlight or callout in short reel shots — swipe or flash across titles, captions, product features, or UI elements to draw attention and emphasize key text or moments.

assets.title: Young Man Analyzing Financial Reports Coins Laptop
assets.detailedDescription: Vertical portrait of a young man in a light blue button-down shirt seated at a wooden desk in a warm-toned office. He is intently reviewing printed financial charts (bar and pie charts) with a pen in hand. Foreground shows stacked gold coins and loose coins, a calculator, notebook, and a laptop at the right edge. Background includes a bookshelf, potted plant and a desk lamp providing side lighting. Composition is a medium-close, slightly top-down desk view with shallow depth of field and natural/warm accent lighting, conveying focus and professional concentration.
assets.useCase: B-roll or close cut for a short reel about budgeting, accounting, small-business finance, investment planning, or an explainer overlay while a voiceover discusses financial metrics.

assets.title: Youtube Play Rounded Red
assets.detailedDescription: Flat, high-contrast YouTube play button icon: a saturated red rounded-rectangle (pill) shape with smooth, organic corners and a centered white equilateral play triangle. Clean vector-like edges, uniform fill, no text, no drop shadow, and a transparent background. 1:1 square canvas optimized for overlays and UI use.
assets.useCase: Use as a video CTA overlay, channel link button, end-screen graphic, or animated tap target in short reels and social videos.
